recipes.title: Vegetable Spring Rolls

ingredients.name: Wonton wrappers, large spring roll size

steps: Stir-fry the vegetables in a little oil for 2 minutes with the soy sauce and sesame oil. Cool and drain.
Roll a spoonful in each wrapper, tucking in the sides, and seal with water.
Fry at 180°C for 3-4 minutes until golden. Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Potstickers
steps: Salt the cabbage for 10 minutes, squeeze dry and mix with the pork, green onions, ginger, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Fill and pleat each wrapper.
Fry in the oil for 2 minutes until the bottoms brown, add 100 ml water, cover and steam 6 minutes. Uncover and crisp. Serve with vinegar.

recipes.title: Fresh Lemonade
steps: Heat the sugar with 250 ml water until dissolved. Cool.
Mix with the lemon juice and the rest of the water. Serve over ice with mint.

recipes.title: Iced Tea with Peach
steps: Steep the tea in 500 ml boiling water with the sugar for 5 minutes, then remove the bags.
Add the rest of the cold water, the peaches and lemon slices and chill for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Mango Lassi
steps: Blend everything with a handful of ice until smooth.
Taste and add more sugar if the mangoes are tart, then pour into glasses.

recipes.title: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth and serve straight away.
Add a few ice cubes or use frozen fruit for a thicker, colder smoothie.

recipes.title: Horchata
steps: Soak the rice and cinnamon in 750 ml water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Blend until very smooth, then strain through a fine sieve or cloth.
Stir in the rest of the water, the sugar, almond milk and vanilla. Serve over ice.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate
steps: Warm the milk with the cocoa and sugar, whisking.
Add the chocolate and whisk until melted and frothy. Stir in the vanilla.

recipes.title: Masala Chai
steps: Simmer the water with the spices for 5 minutes.
Add the milk, tea and sugar and bring just to a boil. Simmer 2 minutes and strain.

recipes.title: Golden Milk
steps: Warm everything together, whisking, until steaming. Do not boil.
Pour into mugs and dust with a little more cinnamon.

recipes.title: Iced Coffee
steps: Fill glasses with ice, pour over the coffee and milk and sweeten with maple syrup.
Stir well and taste; add more milk or syrup to your liking.

recipes.title: Watermelon Agua Fresca
steps: Blend the watermelon with the water, lime juice and sugar until smooth.
Strain if you like and serve over ice.

recipes.title: Sparkling Ginger Limeade
steps: Simmer the ginger and sugar with 150 ml water for 5 minutes. Cool and strain.
Mix with the lime juice and top with sparkling water and ice.

recipes.title: Cranberry Orange Cooler
steps: Combine everything in a jug with ice and serve.
Add the sparkling water just before serving so it stays fizzy.

recipes.title: Sangria
steps: Mix the wine, fruit and sugar and chill for at least 2 hours.
Top with sparkling water and serve over ice. Contains alcohol.

recipes.title: Blueberry Oat Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Let it stand 2 minutes to thicken slightly, then pour into glasses.

recipes.title: Vanilla Milkshake
steps: Blend until smooth and thick and pour into chilled glasses.
Add a little more milk for a thinner shake or more ice cream for a thicker one.

recipes.title: Moussaka
steps: Brush the eggplant with oil and roast at 200°C (180°C fan) for 20 minutes.
Brown the lamb with the onion and garlic, add the tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer 20 minutes.
Make a white sauce with the butter, flour and milk, then beat in the egg and half the cheese.
Layer eggplant and lamb in a dish, top with the sauce and cheese and bake 35-40 minutes. Rest 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pastitsio-Style Baked Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta 2 minutes under the packet time.
Brown the beef and onion, add the tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer 15 minutes.
Make a thick white sauce with the butter, flour and milk; cool slightly and beat in the eggs and half the cheese.
Layer half the pasta, the meat, then the rest of the pasta in a dish, pour over the sauce, add the cheese and bake at 180°C (160°C fan) for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Gigantes-Style Baked Beans
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the beans and 150 ml water and pour into a baking dish.
Bake at 190°C (170°C fan) for 35-40 minutes until thick. Stir in the dill and crumble over feta.

recipes.title: Ratatouille Omelette Pie
steps: Soften the vegetables in the oil with the herbs in an ovenproof pan for 12 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs with salt, scatter with cheese and cook on the stove for 3 minutes.
Finish under a hot grill or in a 200°C oven for 10 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Croque Monsieur
steps: Make a quick white sauce with the butter, flour and milk; stir in half the cheese and the mustard.
Make sandwiches with the ham and a little sauce. Spread the rest of the sauce on top and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Bake at 220°C (200°C fan) for 10-12 minutes until bubbling and golden.

recipes.title: Chicken Provencal
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Add the onion, garlic, tomatoes, olives, herbs and wine around the chicken.
Roast at 200°C (180°C fan) for 35 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the tomatoes have burst.

recipes.title: Doro Wat-Style Spiced Chicken Stew

ingredients.name: Chili powder, or berbere spice blend

steps: Cook the onions in a dry pot over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring, then add the butter and cook 15 minutes more until deep brown.
Add the spice, garlic, ginger and tomato paste for 2 minutes, then the stock and chicken.
Simmer, covered, for 40 minutes until tender. Add the eggs for the last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Suya-Spiced Beef Skewers
steps: Mix the peanuts with the spices and a teaspoon of salt.
Toss the beef with the oil and most of the spice mix, then thread onto skewers.
Grill over high heat for 3-4 minutes per side. Sprinkle with the rest of the spice and serve with sliced onion.

recipes.title: Peri-Peri Chicken
steps: Blend the chilies, garlic, lemon juice, paprika, oregano, oil, vinegar and 1 teaspoon salt.
Rub over the chicken and marinate for 30 minutes or longer.
Roast at 210°C (190°C fan) for 40-45 minutes until the juices run clear. Rest 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Bobotie
steps: Brown the beef and onion, add the curry powder, then mix in the squeezed bread, chutney, raisins and jam.
Press into a baking dish. Beat the eggs with the milk and pour over; tuck in the bay leaves.
Bake at 180°C (160°C fan) for 35-40 minutes until the custard is set.

recipes.title: Egusi-Inspired Spinach Peanut Stew
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, add the tomatoes and habanero and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the peanut butter and stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the black-eyed peas and spinach and cook 5 minutes. Remove the habanero before serving.

recipes.title: Koshari
steps: Fry the onions in the oil until crisp and brown; drain and keep the oil.
Cook the lentils for 15 minutes, add the rice and 400 ml water and cook covered 15 minutes. Cook the pasta separately.
Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, cumin, vinegar and a spoon of onion oil for 10 minutes.
Layer the rice-lentils, pasta and chickpeas, spoon over the sauce and top with the crispy onions.

recipes.title: Curry Goat-Style Lamb Curry
steps: Rub the lamb with 2 tablespoons curry powder, garlic, ginger, thyme, allspice and salt.
Toast the rest of the curry powder in the oil, add the lamb and brown, then the onion and habanero.
Add 600 ml water, cover and simmer 1.5 hours. Add the potatoes and cook 30 minutes more.

recipes.title: Brown Stew Chicken
steps: Season the chicken with the soy sauce, garlic, thyme, allspice and salt.
Heat the oil with the sugar until it darkens, then brown the chicken in it.
Add the vegetables, ketchup and 300 ml water, cover and simmer 35-40 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Rice and Peas with Jerk Tofu
steps: Toss the tofu with the jerk seasoning and roast with the oil at 220°C (200°C fan) for 25 minutes.
Simmer the coconut milk with 200 ml water, green onions, thyme and salt, add the rice and beans and cook covered for 20 minutes.
Serve the tofu over the rice and peas.

recipes.title: Sancocho-Style Chicken Stew
steps: Brown the chicken, then add the onion and garlic.
Add the stock, plantains and oregano and simmer 25 minutes.
Add the potatoes and corn and simmer 25 minutes more. Finish with cilantro and lime.

recipes.title: One-Pot Chicken and Orzo
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil, add the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the orzo and stock and simmer, stirring, for 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and lemon juice and top with feta.

recipes.title: One-Pot Sausage and Lentil Stew
steps: Brown the sausage in the oil, add the onion and carrots for 6 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock and simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the kale for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.title: One-Pot Cheeseburger Pasta
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and drain off excess fat.
Add the pasta, tomatoes, stock, ketchup and mustard and simmer, covered, for 12 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the cheese until melted.

recipes.title: One-Pot Coconut Chickpea Rice
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, stir in the curry powder and rice.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk, water and salt, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes.
Fold in the spinach and rest 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Put the chicken, onion, curry paste, tomatoes and ginger garlic paste in the slow cooker with 1 teaspoon salt.
Cook on low for 5 hours.
Stir in the cream and cook 15 minutes more. Scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Black Bean Soup
steps: Drain the beans and put everything except the lime in the slow cooker.
Cook on low for 7 hours until the beans are very soft.
Blend part of the soup, season and finish with lime juice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pulled Chicken BBQ Sandwiches
steps: Put the onion and chicken in the slow cooker and pour over the BBQ sauce and vinegar.
Cook on low for 5 hours, then shred in the sauce.
Pile into buns with cabbage.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Vegetable Curry
steps: Put everything except the spinach in the slow cooker with 1 teaspoon salt.
Cook on low for 6 hours. Stir in the spinach for the last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Chili
steps: Put everything in the slow cooker with 1.5 teaspoons salt and stir.
Cook on low for 8 hours. Serve with cheese, sour cream or rice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Ramen Broth
steps: Put the pork, stock, soy sauce, mirin, garlic and ginger in the slow cooker. Cook on low for 8 hours.
Shred the pork and strain the broth.
Cook the noodles and divide between bowls with the broth, pork, halved eggs and green onions.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Falafel
steps: Drain the chickpeas and pulse with the onion, garlic, parsley, cumin and 1 teaspoon salt until finely chopped. Stir in the baking powder.
Shape into 20 patties and brush with oil.
Air fry at 190°C for 12-15 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Pork Chops
steps: Rub the chops with oil, spices, sugar and salt.
Air fry at 200°C for 10-12 minutes, turning halfway, until 63°C inside. Rest 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Tofu Bites
steps: Toss the tofu with the soy sauce and sesame oil, then the cornstarch.
Air fry at 200°C for 14-15 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp. Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Meatballs
steps: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, seasoning and salt and roll into 16 balls.
Air fry at 190°C for 10-12 minutes until browned and cooked.
Warm the marinara and toss the meatballs in it. Serve with pasta or in rolls.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Shrimp
steps: Toss the shrimp with the oil, seasoning and garlic.
Air fry at 200°C for 6-8 minutes, shaking halfway, until pink. Squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Budget Bean and Rice Burritos
steps: Mash the beans in a pan with the spices and a splash of water until hot.
Fill each tortilla with rice, beans, cheese and salsa and roll up.
Toast seam side down in a dry pan for 2 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Budget Potato and Egg Curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the paste and curry powder.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes and 250 ml water and simmer 18 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Score the eggs, add to the curry and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Budget Cabbage and Sausage Skillet
steps: Brown the sausage in the oil, then add the onion and cabbage.
Cook, stirring, for 12-15 minutes until the cabbage is tender and browned in places.
Season with the paprika, vinegar, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Budget Tuna Rice Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan).
Mix the rice, tuna, soup and peas and spread in a dish.
Top with cheese and bake 20-25 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.title: Budget Lentil Sloppy Joes
steps: Simmer the lentils in water for 20 minutes until soft, then drain.
Soften the onion and pepper in the oil, then add the lentils, ketchup, vinegar, sugar and chili powder with a splash of water.
Simmer 5 minutes and spoon into buns.

recipes.title: Pantry Black Bean Soup
steps: Simmer the beans, salsa, stock and cumin for 15 minutes.
Blend half of the soup and stir it back in. Season and add lime juice.

recipes.title: Pantry Tomato Rice Soup
steps: Soften the onion in the butter, add the tomatoes, stock and sugar and simmer 10 minutes. Blend.
Add the rice and simmer 15 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Egg and Pea Fried Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Scramble the eggs in the oil, add the peas for 2 minutes, then the noodles, soy sauce and green onions. Toss until hot.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Chicken Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and put the chicken in a baking dish.
Mix the yogurt, parmesan, garlic powder, oregano, lemon zest and salt and spread over the chicken.
Bake 25-30 minutes until golden and cooked through.

recipes.title: Loaded Sheet Pan Nachos with Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Spread the chips on a tray and scatter with chicken, beans, cheese and jalapeno.
Bake 10-12 minutes until the cheese melts. Top with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Sausage and Vegetables
steps: Toss the potatoes with 1 tablespoon oil and roast at 220°C (200°C fan) for 15 minutes.
Add everything else, toss with the rest of the oil and seasoning, and roast 15 minutes more.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Salmon with Green Beans
steps: Toss the beans with 1 tablespoon oil and salt on a tray and add the salmon.
Mix the soy sauce, honey, garlic and rest of the oil and brush over the salmon.
Roast at 210°C (190°C fan) for 12-15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Tofu and Broccoli
steps: Toss the tofu with 1 tablespoon oil, 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch. Spread on a lined tray.
Roast at 220°C (200°C fan) for 15 minutes, add the broccoli tossed with the rest of the oil and roast 10 minutes more.
Toss with the remaining soy sauce, maple syrup and sriracha.

recipes.title: Banana Walnut Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan, 400°F) and line a 12-hole muffin tin with paper cases.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in a large bowl.
In a jug, whisk the mashed bananas, brown sugar, eggs, milk and oil.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and fold with a spatula until just combined; a few lumps are fine. Fold in most of the walnuts.
Spoon the batter into the cases. Scatter over the last walnuts, then bake for 20 minutes, until risen and a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then lift onto a rack. They keep for 2 days in a tin or 2 months in the freezer.

recipes.title: Lemon Poppy Seed Muffins

recipes.title: Pear and Ginger Overnight Oats
steps: In a bowl or two jars, stir together the oats, chia seeds, milk and yogurt.
Stir in the grated pear and ground ginger. Cover and chill overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
In the morning, loosen with a splash more milk if it is too thick and top with walnuts and a drizzle of maple syrup. Eat cold, or warm for 1 minute in the microwave.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
steps: In a bowl or two jars, stir together the oats, chia seeds, milk and yogurt.
Stir in the peanut butter and honey. Cover and chill overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
In the morning, loosen with a splash more milk if it is too thick and top with banana slices. Eat cold, or warm for 1 minute in the microwave.

Stir in the coconut and maple syrup. Cover and chill overnight, or for at least 4 hours.

steps: In a bowl or two jars, stir together the oats, chia seeds, almond milk and yogurt.

In the morning, loosen with a splash more almond milk if it is too thick and top with the rest of the raspberries and the almonds. Eat cold, or warm for 1 minute in the microwave.

recipes.title: Potato and Onion Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F). Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Cook the potatoes and onion in the oil over medium heat, covered, for 12 minutes until tender, stirring now and then, using a 24 cm ovenproof frying pan.
Pour in the eggs and scatter over a handful of parsley. Cook on the hob for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and just firm in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges. Good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F). Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Cook the broccoli in the oil with a splash of water, covered, for 5 minutes until just tender, using a 24 cm ovenproof frying pan.
Pour in the eggs and scatter over the cheese. Cook on the hob for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and just firm in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges. Good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Zucchini and Mint Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F). Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Fry the zucchini in the oil for 6 minutes until golden at the edges, using a 24 cm ovenproof frying pan.
Pour in the eggs and scatter over the parmesan and mint. Cook on the hob for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and just firm in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges. Good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Sausage and Pepper Egg Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F). Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Brown the sausages in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the pepper and cook 3 minutes more, using a 24 cm ovenproof frying pan.
Pour in the eggs and scatter over the cheese. Cook on the hob for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and just firm in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges. Good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Asparagus and Goat Cheese Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F). Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Cook the asparagus in the oil for 4 minutes until bright green, using a 24 cm ovenproof frying pan.
Pour in the eggs and scatter over the goat cheese and chives. Cook on the hob for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and just firm in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges. Good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Spinach Egg Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F). Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil for 6 minutes until browned, add the garlic and spinach and stir until wilted, using a 24 cm ovenproof frying pan.
Pour in the eggs and scatter over the mozzarella. Cook on the hob for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and just firm in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges. Good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Leftover Pasta Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F). Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Warm the cooked pasta in the oil for 2 minutes, spreading it out in an even layer, using a 24 cm ovenproof frying pan.
Pour in the eggs and scatter over the parmesan and torn basil. Cook on the hob for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and just firm in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges. Good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Kale Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F). Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Cook the sweet potato in the oil, covered, for 10 minutes until tender, then stir in the kale for 1 minute, using a 24 cm ovenproof frying pan.
Pour in the eggs and scatter over the feta. Cook on the hob for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and just firm in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges. Good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon and Dill Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F). Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Soften the green onions in the oil for 2 minutes, using a 24 cm ovenproof frying pan.
Pour in the eggs and scatter over the salmon, small spoonfuls of cream cheese and the dill. Cook on the hob for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and just firm in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges. Good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Chorizo and Potato Egg Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F). Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Fry the chorizo for 2 minutes until it releases its oil, then add the potatoes and onion, cover and cook 12 minutes until tender, using a 24 cm ovenproof frying pan.
Pour in the eggs and scatter over the smoked paprika. Cook on the hob for 2 minutes until the edges set.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and just firm in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, then cut into wedges. Good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Strawberry Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk the wet ingredients in a jug, pour them in and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe it with a little oil. Tip: scatter a few pieces of strawberry over each pancake before flipping.
Cook ladlefuls of batter for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the underside is golden, flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk the wet ingredients in a jug, pour them in and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe it with a little oil. Tip: blend everything until smooth first.
Cook ladlefuls of batter for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the underside is golden, flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with sliced banana and honey.

recipes.title: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk the wet ingredients in a jug, pour them in and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe it with a little oil. Tip: use a gentle heat, as they brown quickly.
Cook ladlefuls of batter for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the underside is golden, flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with berries and powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Pancakes
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk the wet ingredients in a jug, pour them in and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe it with a little oil. Tip: let the batter rest 5 minutes so the cornmeal softens.
Cook ladlefuls of batter for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the underside is golden, flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with butter and honey.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pancakes
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk the wet ingredients in a jug, pour them in and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe it with a little oil. Tip: sprinkle chocolate chips over each pancake before flipping.
Cook ladlefuls of batter for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the underside is golden, flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with sliced strawberries.

recipes.title: Vegan Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk the wet ingredients in a jug, pour them in and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe it with a little oil. Tip: stir the vinegar into the soy milk 5 minutes before you start.
Cook ladlefuls of batter for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the underside is golden, flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with maple syrup and fruit.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Apple Pancakes
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk the wet ingredients in a jug, pour them in and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe it with a little oil. Tip: stir the grated apple into the batter last.
Cook ladlefuls of batter for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the underside is golden, flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with yogurt and maple syrup.

recipes.title: Savory Scallion Pancakes with Egg
steps: Whisk the batter ingredients together until smooth (the eggs go into the batter), then let it rest for 10 minutes.
Heat a little oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in a quarter of the batter and tilt to spread it thinly. Cook 3 minutes, pressing flat with a spatula, until golden underneath, then flip and cook 2 minutes more.
Repeat with the rest of the batter. Serve hot with soy sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Crisp Vanilla Waffles
steps: Whisk the batter ingredients together until smooth, then let it rest for 10 minutes.
Heat a waffle iron and brush it with a little oil.
Pour in enough batter to just cover the grid, close and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Repeat with the rest of the batter. Serve hot with whipped cream and strawberries.

recipes.title: Buckwheat Crepes with Ham and Cheese
steps: Whisk the batter ingredients together until smooth, then let it rest for 10 minutes.
Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe it with butter.

Pour in a quarter of the batter and swirl to coat the pan thinly. Cook 2 minutes, flip, then lay a slice of ham and some cheese in the middle. Fold in the four sides to make a square and cook until the cheese melts.
Repeat with the rest of the batter. Serve hot with a green salad.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pancakes
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk the wet ingredients in a jug, pour them in and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe it with a little oil. Tip: cook a little lower and slower than usual so the middles set.
Cook ladlefuls of batter for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the underside is golden, flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with maple syrup and pecans.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Protein Pancakes
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk the wet ingredients in a jug, pour them in and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe it with a little oil. Tip: blend everything until smooth first.
Cook ladlefuls of batter for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear and the underside is golden, flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with berries.

recipes.title: Ricotta Toast with Honey and Figs
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Spread thickly with ricotta, lay over the figs, drizzle with honey and scatter with pistachios.
Eat straight away.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Spread with peanut butter, top with banana slices, dust with cinnamon and drizzle with honey.
Eat straight away.

recipes.title: Tomato and Garlic Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Rub with the cut garlic, then rub the cut tomato hard into the bread until only the skin is left. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Eat straight away.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Egg Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Fry the mushrooms in butter with the thyme for 6 minutes. Fry the eggs in the same pan. Pile the mushrooms and eggs on the toast.
Eat straight away.

recipes.title: Beans on Toast with Cheese
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Heat the beans with the Worcestershire sauce, spoon over the toast and scatter with cheese.
Eat straight away.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Chili and Lime
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt, spread on the toast and finish with chili flakes and cilantro.
Eat straight away.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Cream Cheese Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Spread with cream cheese, top with cucumber and smoked salmon and finish with dill and a squeeze of lemon.
Eat straight away.

recipes.title: Hummus Toast with Cucumber
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Spread with hummus, top with cucumber and tomatoes, then sprinkle with za'atar and drizzle with oil.
Eat straight away.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon. Spread the bread with butter, sprinkle generously and grill for 1 to 2 minutes until bubbling.
Eat straight away.

recipes.title: Spinach and Feta Egg Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Wilt the spinach in the oil, then scramble the eggs into it and stir in the feta. Pile onto the toast.
Eat straight away.

recipes.title: Millet Porridge with Dates
steps: Rinse the millet, then toast it in a dry saucepan for 3 minutes until it smells nutty.
Add the milk, water, dates, cinnamon and salt. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 20 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Spoon into bowls and top with the toasted almonds.

recipes.title: Barley Breakfast Porridge with Pear
steps: Rinse the barley and simmer it in the water with the salt for 30 minutes until tender (or soak it overnight to save 10 minutes).
Add the milk, pears and cardamom and cook 10 minutes more, stirring, until creamy.
Sweeten with the honey and serve warm.

recipes.title: Savory Oats with Fried Egg
steps: Simmer the oats in the stock for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick. Stir in the parmesan.
Meanwhile fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Spoon the oats into bowls, top each with an egg, the green onions and a few drops of hot sauce.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice Pudding Porridge
steps: Rinse the rice, then simmer it with the coconut milk, water, sugar and salt for 25 minutes, stirring often, until thick and soft.
Add a splash more water if it gets too thick.
Serve warm topped with the mango and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Porridge with Nutmeg
steps: Whisk the cornmeal into 200 ml of cold milk until smooth.
Heat the rest of the milk with the spices and salt. When it simmers, whisk in the cornmeal mixture and keep whisking for 2 minutes.
Cook gently for 12 minutes, stirring often, until thick. Stir in the vanilla and condensed milk and serve hot.

recipes.title: Buckwheat Porridge with Apple
steps: Rinse the buckwheat, then simmer it in the water with the salt, covered, for 10 minutes.
Add the milk and apple and cook 5 minutes more until soft and creamy.
Stir in the butter and honey and serve.

recipes.title: Black Bean Breakfast Burritos
steps: Warm the black beans with the cumin and a splash of water, mashing a few.
Scramble the eggs in the oil over low heat.
Warm the tortillas, fill each with beans, eggs, cheese, salsa and avocado, fold in the sides and roll up.
Toast the burritos seam side down in a dry pan for 1 minute per side.

recipes.title: Tofu Breakfast Burritos
steps: Fry the pepper in the oil for 4 minutes. Crumble in the tofu with the turmeric, cumin and a pinch of salt and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the black beans to warm through.
Fill the warmed tortillas with the tofu, salsa and avocado and roll up.

recipes.title: Sausage and Egg Breakfast Muffins
steps: Mix the pork with the sage, salt and pepper and shape into 4 thin patties a little wider than the muffins.
Fry the patties in the oil for 4 minutes per side until cooked through. Top each with cheese for the last minute.
Fry the eggs, toast the muffins and stack muffin, patty, egg, muffin.

recipes.title: Corned Beef-Style Potato Hash
steps: Boil the potatoes for 6 minutes, then drain well.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the potatoes and press down. Cook 10 minutes, turning now and then, until crusty.
Stir in the beef and Worcestershire sauce and heat through. Make 4 hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 4 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Chickpea Breakfast Hash
steps: Fry the potatoes in the oil, covered, for 10 minutes until nearly tender.
Add the onion, chickpeas and spices and fry uncovered 6 minutes until crisp. Stir in the spinach.
Make 4 hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 4 minutes. Serve with a spoon of yogurt.

recipes.title: Breakfast Tostadas
steps: Brush the tortillas with oil and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 8 minutes until crisp, or fry them.
Warm the beans and fry the eggs.
Spread the tostadas with beans and top with an egg, salsa, queso fresco and avocado.

recipes.title: Chorizo Egg Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Fry the chorizo for 2 minutes, then scramble the eggs softly with it in half the butter with the green onions.
Lay the eggs over half of each tortilla, scatter with cheese and fold.
Cook in the rest of the butter for 2 minutes per side until golden. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Japanese-Style Egg Sandwich
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Mash the eggs with a fork and mix in the mayonnaise, sugar, milk, salt and white pepper.
Spread thickly between the bread, press gently, trim the crusts if you like and cut in half.

recipes.title: Croissant Breakfast Sandwiches
steps: Scramble the eggs softly in the butter with a pinch of pepper.
Fill each croissant with ham, cheese and egg.
Warm in a 180°C (350°F) oven for 4 minutes until the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza with Bacon and Egg
steps: Heat the oven to 240°C (220°C fan, 475°F). Stretch the dough onto an oiled tray.
Scatter with mozzarella and bacon and bake for 7 minutes.
Crack the eggs onto the pizza and bake 6 to 8 minutes more until the whites set. Finish with green onions.

recipes.title: Maple Pecan Granola
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan, 325°F) and line a large tray with baking paper.
Mix everything except the raisins in a large bowl until the oats are evenly coated.
Spread thinly on the tray and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden.
Leave to cool on the tray (it crisps as it cools), then mix in the raisins. Keeps 3 weeks in a jar.

recipes.title: Seeded Olive Oil Granola
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan, 325°F) and line a large tray with baking paper.
Mix everything except the apricots in a large bowl until the oats are evenly coated.
Spread thinly on the tray and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden.
Leave to cool on the tray (it crisps as it cools), then mix in the apricots. Keeps 3 weeks in a jar.

recipes.title: Coconut Cashew Granola
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan, 325°F) and line a large tray with baking paper.
Mix everything except the cranberries in a large bowl until the oats are evenly coated.
Spread thinly on the tray and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden.
Leave to cool on the tray (it crisps as it cools), then mix in the cranberries. Keeps 3 weeks in a jar.

recipes.title: Chocolate Hazelnut Granola
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan, 325°F) and line a large tray with baking paper.
Mix everything except the chocolate chips in a large bowl until the oats are evenly coated.
Spread thinly on the tray and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden.
Leave to cool on the tray (it crisps as it cools), then mix in the chocolate chips once completely cool. Keeps 3 weeks in a jar.

recipes.title: Blueberry Baked Oatmeal
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Mix the oats, baking powder and salt. Whisk the milk, eggs, maple syrup, butter and vanilla and stir into the oats.
Pour into the dish. Scatter the blueberries over the top.
Bake for 35 minutes until set and golden. Serve warm, cut into squares, with a splash of milk or yogurt. Reheats well.

recipes.title: Raspberry Coconut Baked Oatmeal
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Mix the oats, baking powder and salt. Whisk the milk, eggs, maple syrup, butter and vanilla and stir into the oats.
Pour into the dish. Stir in the coconut and scatter the raspberries over the top.
Bake for 35 minutes until set and golden. Serve warm, cut into squares, with a splash of milk or yogurt. Reheats well.

recipes.title: Banana Chocolate Chip Baked Oatmeal
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Mix the oats, baking powder and salt. Whisk the milk, eggs, maple syrup, butter and vanilla and stir into the oats.
Pour into the dish. Lay the banana slices on top and scatter with chocolate chips.
Bake for 35 minutes until set and golden. Serve warm, cut into squares, with a splash of milk or yogurt. Reheats well.

recipes.title: Peach Almond Baked Oatmeal
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan, 375°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Mix the oats, baking powder and salt. Whisk the milk, eggs, maple syrup, butter and vanilla and stir into the oats.
Pour into the dish. Stir in the almond extract, lay the peaches on top and scatter with almonds.
Bake for 35 minutes until set and golden. Serve warm, cut into squares, with a splash of milk or yogurt. Reheats well.

recipes.title: Chicken Pesto Ciabatta

ingredients.name: Ciabatta, cut into 2 sandwich lengths and split

steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Spread the rolls with pesto, then layer the chicken, mozzarella, tomato and arugula.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Turkey Cranberry Sandwich
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Spread two slices with mayonnaise and two with cranberry sauce. Fill with turkey, cheese and lettuce.
Cut in half and serve straight away, or wrap tightly for a packed lunch.

recipes.title: Open-Faced Tuna Cheddar Melts
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, celery and lemon juice. Butter and toast the bread, spread with the tuna, top with cheese and grill for 3 to 4 minutes until bubbling.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chickpea Salad Sandwich
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Mash the chickpeas roughly with a fork and mix in the mayonnaise, mustard, celery, dill and lemon juice. Season and pile between the bread with lettuce.
Cut in half and serve straight away, or wrap tightly for a packed lunch.

recipes.title: Chive and Mustard Egg Salad Rolls
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Chop them and mix with the mayonnaise, mustard, chives, salt and pepper. Split the rolls and fill generously.
Cut in half and serve straight away, or wrap tightly for a packed lunch.

recipes.title: Caprese Baguette
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Split the baguette, drizzle with olive oil and layer with tomato, mozzarella and basil. Finish with balsamic glaze and cut into four.
Cut in half and serve straight away, or wrap tightly for a packed lunch.

recipes.title: Ham and Swiss Panini
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Spread the bread with mustard and fill with ham and cheese. Butter the outsides and press in a hot pan under a heavy pan for 3 minutes per side.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Halloumi and Roasted Pepper Wraps
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Fry the halloumi in the oil for 2 minutes per side until golden and squeeze over a little lemon. Spread the tortillas with hummus, add spinach, peppers and halloumi and roll up.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Toss the chicken in the buffalo sauce. Fill the tortillas with lettuce, carrot, chicken and a drizzle of ranch, then roll up tightly.
Cut in half and serve straight away, or wrap tightly for a packed lunch.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Pitas with Tzatziki
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Toss the chicken with oregano, lemon juice and oil and fry for 8 minutes until cooked. Warm the pitas and fill with chicken, tomato, onion and tzatziki.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Club Sandwich
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Fry the bacon until crisp and toast the bread. Spread with mayonnaise and stack in three layers: chicken and lettuce, then bacon and tomato. Hold together with cocktail sticks.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Pulled Chicken BBQ Sliders
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Warm the chicken in the BBQ sauce. Toss the cabbage with mayonnaise and vinegar. Pile the chicken and slaw into the split rolls.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Chicken Banh Mi
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.

Toss the carrot and cucumber with the vinegar and sugar. Fry the chicken in a little oil with the lemongrass paste for 6 minutes until cooked, then add the fish sauce. Spread the bread with mayonnaise mixed with sriracha and fill with chicken, pickles and cilantro.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Turkey Avocado Club Wraps
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Spread the tortillas with mayonnaise, then layer with lettuce, turkey, bacon, tomato and avocado. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Cut in half and serve straight away, or wrap tightly for a packed lunch.

recipes.title: Portobello Cheesesteak Sandwiches
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Fry the onion and pepper in half the oil for 6 minutes. Add the rest of the oil and the mushrooms and fry 6 minutes until browned and juicy. Lay the cheese over to melt, then pile into the buns.
Cut in half and serve hot.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Tuna Wraps
steps: Get everything ready before you start: slice, wash and drain the fillings.
Mix the tuna with the olives, tomato, oil and lemon juice. Fill the tortillas with arugula, the tuna and feta, then roll up.
Cut in half and serve straight away, or wrap tightly for a packed lunch.

recipes.title: Sesame Ginger Salmon Rice Bowls
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey and ginger, brush half over the salmon and roast at 200°C (400°F) for 12 minutes, brushing with more halfway.
Divide the rice, cucumber, avocado and edamame between four bowls.
Top with the rest of the sauce and sesame seeds. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Taco-Spiced Chicken Rice Bowls
steps: Toss the chicken with the taco seasoning and fry in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked. Warm the beans and corn together.
Divide the rice, beans and corn between four bowls.
Top with salsa, avocado and a squeeze of lime. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Spiced Lamb Couscous Bowls
steps: Pour 250 ml boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff. Fry the lamb with the cumin and cinnamon for 8 minutes until browned and crisp.
Divide the couscous, cucumber and tomatoes between four bowls.
Top with the lamb, hummus, parsley, a squeeze of lemon and the oil. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Spicy Gochujang Chicken Bowls
steps: Fry the chicken for 8 minutes until browned and cooked, then add the gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger and cook 2 minutes. Fry the eggs.
Divide the rice and chicken between four bowls.
Top with the kimchi, a fried egg and green onions. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Quinoa Power Bowls
steps: Roast the sweet potato and chickpeas with the oil and paprika at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes. Simmer the quinoa in 450 ml water for 15 minutes.
Divide the quinoa, kale, sweet potato and chickpeas between four bowls.
Top with avocado and the tahini thinned with lemon juice and water. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Peanut Tofu Noodle Bowls
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil until golden. Whisk the peanut butter, tamari, lime juice, maple syrup and 4 tbsp hot water. Soak the noodles as the pack says.
Divide the noodles, carrot, pepper and tofu between four bowls.
Top with the peanut sauce and chopped peanuts. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Farro Bowls
steps: Simmer the farro in salted water for 25 minutes until chewy-tender, then drain. Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano.
Divide the farro, chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes and olives between four bowls.
Top with the feta and dressing. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Shrimp Poke Bowls
steps: Cook the rice and season with a splash of rice vinegar if you like. Toss the shrimp with the soy sauce, sesame oil and sriracha.
Divide the rice, mango, cucumber and avocado between four bowls.
Top with the shrimp, green onions and sesame seeds. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Black Bean Sweet Potato Bowls
steps: Roast the sweet potatoes with the oil, cumin and chili at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes. Cook the rice. Warm the beans.
Divide the rice, beans and sweet potatoes between four bowls.
Top with salsa, sliced avocado, lime and cilantro. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
steps: Toss the chicken with the spices, oil and juice of one lemon and roast at 220°C (425°F) for 20 minutes. Mix the yogurt with the garlic and a pinch of salt.
Divide the rice, cucumber and tomato between four bowls.
Top with the chicken, garlic yogurt and lemon wedges. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Miso Salmon Soba Bowls
steps: Mix the miso, honey and vinegar, spread over the salmon and roast at 200°C (400°F) for 12 minutes. Cook the soba with the broccoli for the last 3 minutes, then rinse in cold water.
Divide the soba, broccoli and carrot between four bowls.
Top with flaked salmon and green onions. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Lentil and Roasted Veg Bowls
steps: Roast the eggplant, onion and zucchini with 2 tbsp oil and the cumin at 220°C (425°F) for 25 minutes. Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes, drain and toss with the rest of the oil and lemon juice.
Divide the spinach and lentils between four bowls.
Top with the roasted vegetables and a spoon of yogurt. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days, so these also make good packed lunches.

recipes.title: Chicken and Pepper Quesadillas
steps: Fry the pepper and onion in a little oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Lay four tortillas flat, scatter with half the cheese, then the filling and the rest of the cheese. Top with the other tortillas.
Cook one at a time in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Refried Bean and Jalapeno Quesadillas
steps: Warm the refried beans with the cumin and stir in the jalapenos.
Lay four tortillas flat, scatter with half the cheese, then the filling and the rest of the cheese. Top with the other tortillas.
Cook one at a time in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Spinach and Mushroom Quesadillas
steps: Fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes, add the garlic and spinach and stir until wilted.
Lay four tortillas flat, scatter with half the cheese, then the filling and the rest of the cheese. Top with the other tortillas.
Cook one at a time in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Chipotle Quesadillas
steps: Cook the sweet potato in a little oil for 6 minutes until soft, then stir in the chipotle.
Lay four tortillas flat, scatter with half the cheese, then the filling and the rest of the cheese. Top with the other tortillas.
Cook one at a time in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Steak and Onion Quesadillas
steps: Fry the onion for 5 minutes, then add the steak and chili powder and fry 2 minutes.
Lay four tortillas flat, scatter with half the cheese, then the filling and the rest of the cheese. Top with the other tortillas.
Cook one at a time in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Kimchi Cheese Quesadillas
steps: Squeeze excess juice from the kimchi and mix it with the green onions.
Lay four tortillas flat, scatter with half the cheese, then the filling and the rest of the cheese. Top with the other tortillas.
Cook one at a time in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Four Cheese Naan Pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and put the breads on two large baking trays.
Bake the plain breads for 3 minutes to crisp them, then spread with sauce, top with mozzarella and parmesan and dot with ricotta and goat cheese.
Bake for 7 to 9 minutes until the edges are crisp and the cheese, if any, is bubbling.
Finish with basil, cut into slices and serve.

recipes.title: BBQ Chicken Flatbreads
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and put the breads on two large baking trays.
Bake the plain breads for 3 minutes to crisp them, then spread with BBQ sauce and top with chicken, red onion and mozzarella.
Bake for 7 to 9 minutes until the edges are crisp and the cheese, if any, is bubbling.
Finish with cilantro, cut into slices and serve.

recipes.title: Pesto Veggie Flatbreads
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and put the breads on two large baking trays.
Bake the plain breads for 3 minutes to crisp them, then spread with pesto and top with zucchini, tomatoes and mozzarella.
Bake for 7 to 9 minutes until the edges are crisp and the cheese, if any, is bubbling.
Finish with arugula, cut into slices and serve.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Pita Pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and put the breads on two large baking trays.
Bake the plain breads for 3 minutes to crisp them, then spread with sauce, top with mozzarella and pepperoni and sprinkle with oregano.
Bake for 7 to 9 minutes until the edges are crisp and the cheese, if any, is bubbling.
Finish with a few chili flakes if you like, cut into slices and serve.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Goat Cheese Flatbreads
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and put the breads on two large baking trays.
Bake the plain breads for 3 minutes to crisp them, then top with the mushrooms (first fried in the oil with thyme for 5 minutes), mozzarella and crumbled goat cheese.
Bake for 7 to 9 minutes until the edges are crisp and the cheese, if any, is bubbling.
Finish with a drizzle of honey, cut into slices and serve.

recipes.title: Greek Pita Pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and put the breads on two large baking trays.
Bake the plain breads for 3 minutes to crisp them, then spread with hummus and top with spinach, olives, onion and feta.
Bake for 7 to 9 minutes until the edges are crisp and the cheese, if any, is bubbling.
Finish with a drizzle of olive oil, cut into slices and serve.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Tortilla Pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and put the breads on two large baking trays.
Bake the plain breads for 3 minutes to crisp them, then spread with sauce and top with mozzarella, ham and pineapple.
Bake for 7 to 9 minutes until the edges are crisp and the cheese, if any, is bubbling.
Finish with a pinch of black pepper, cut into slices and serve.

recipes.title: Vegan Hummus Veggie Flatbreads
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and put the breads on two large baking trays.
Bake the plain breads for 3 minutes to crisp them, then spread with hummus and top with pepper, onion and tomatoes tossed in the oil.
Bake for 7 to 9 minutes until the edges are crisp and the cheese, if any, is bubbling.
Finish with za'atar and parsley, cut into slices and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
steps: Fry the chicken in the oil over high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the garlic, ginger and water chestnuts and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the hoisin, soy sauce and vinegar and cook 1 minute more. Add the green onions.
Spoon into the lettuce cups and eat with your hands.

recipes.title: Tofu Lettuce Cups
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil over high heat for 6 minutes until golden and a little crisp.
Add the mushrooms and garlic and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the hoisin, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Fill the lettuce cups with the tofu, grated carrot and peanuts.

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Potatoes with Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake for 55 to 60 minutes until the skins are crisp.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Split the potatoes, fluff the insides with a fork and fill with broccoli and cheese. Return to the oven for 5 minutes to melt.
Top with sour cream and green onions.

recipes.title: Tuna Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water as the pack says, drain and rinse in cold water.
Mix the mayonnaise, yogurt and lemon juice in a large bowl.
Add the pasta, tuna, sweetcorn, pepper and green onions and toss. Season and chill until lunch.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Crunch Wraps
steps: Toss the lettuce, chicken and parmesan with the dressing.
Add the crushed croutons for crunch.
Pile onto the tortillas, fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Cut in half to serve.

recipes.title: Hummus and Veggie Snack Box
steps: Divide the hummus between two small pots.
Pack the vegetables, pita wedges and olives around them in two lunch boxes.
Keep chilled until lunchtime.

recipes.title: Cheese and Pickle Ploughman's Plate
steps: Arrange the cheese, ham, apple, pickles and lettuce on two plates.
Add a spoon of relish to each.
Serve with the bread rolls and butter.

recipes.title: Leftover Rice Fried Egg Bowl
steps: Warm the rice in a pan with a splash of water, covered, for 3 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the oil until crispy at the edges.
Divide the rice between bowls, drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil, top with the eggs, green onions, furikake and chili oil.

recipes.title: Pita Pizza Snack Pockets
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Split each pita into a pocket and fill with sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese melts and the bread is crisp. Cut in half.

recipes.title: Sardines on Toast with Tomato
steps: Toast the bread and drizzle with a little oil from the can.
Lay on the tomato slices and the sardines, mashing them lightly.
Finish with lemon juice, chili flakes and parsley.

recipes.title: Cucumber Cream Cheese Sandwiches
steps: Mix the cream cheese with the dill and a little pepper.
Spread on all the bread, then layer cucumber over half the slices and sprinkle with salt.
Close the sandwiches, cut off the crusts and cut each into four fingers.

recipes.title: Cashew Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the soy sauce, hoisin and vinegar with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the pepper, onion and cashews. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the green onions and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Chicken and Mushroom Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the oyster sauce, soy sauce and sugar with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until cooked through, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the mushrooms and snow peas. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the sesame seeds and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Garlic Shrimp and Snow Pea Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the soy sauce, rice wine, sugar and sesame oil with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the shrimp for 2 minutes until pink, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the snow peas and carrot. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the shrimp to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the green onions and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Tofu Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Firm tofu, cubed and patted dry

steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the ketchup, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the tofu for 6 minutes until golden on all sides, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the pepper, onion and pineapple. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the tofu to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the sesame seeds and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Chicken
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the oyster sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce and sugar with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until browned, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the chilies, shallots and green beans. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the thai basil and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Pork and Pepper Black Bean Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the black bean sauce, soy sauce and sugar with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the pork for 3 minutes until browned, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the peppers and onion. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the pork to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the red chili and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken and Vegetables
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the teriyaki sauce and honey with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 6 minutes until golden and cooked through, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the broccoli, carrot and pepper. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the sesame seeds and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Kung Pao-Style Tofu

ingredients.name: Firm tofu, cubed and patted dry
Green onions, cut into short lengths

steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and chili flakes with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the tofu for 6 minutes until crisp, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the pepper, green onions and peanuts. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the tofu to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the sesame oil and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Crispy Sweet Chili Beef

ingredients.name: Steak, thinly sliced and tossed in 2 tbsp cornstarch
Green onions, cut into short lengths

steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the sweet chili sauce, soy sauce and vinegar with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the beef for 3 minutes until crisp at the edges, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the pepper and green onions. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the beef to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the sesame seeds and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Chow Mein
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says, drain and toss with a few drops of oil. Whisk the soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 4 minutes until cooked through, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the cabbage, carrot and bean sprouts. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan with the noodles, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the green onions and serve.

recipes.title: Hoisin Tofu Noodle Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the noodles as the pack says, drain and toss with a few drops of oil. Whisk the soy sauce, hoisin and sesame oil with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the tofu for 5 minutes until golden, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the mushrooms, bok choy and carrot. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the tofu to the pan with the noodles, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the green onions and serve.

recipes.title: Ginger Beef with Peppers
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, honey and the ginger matchsticks with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the beef for 2 minutes until browned, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the peppers and onion. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Return the beef to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the cilantro and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Szechuan-Style Eggplant
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the doubanjiang, soy sauce, vinegar and sugar with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the eggplant for 8 minutes until soft and browned (add a splash of water to help), then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the green onions. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the eggplant to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the cilantro and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Pork Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the honey, soy sauce and vinegar with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the pork for 3 minutes until browned, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the snow peas and pepper. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the pork to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the sesame seeds and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Tempeh and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the kecap manis, tamari and sambal with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the tempeh for 6 minutes until golden, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the broccoli and pepper with 3 tbsp water. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the tempeh to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the peanuts and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the lemongrass paste, fish sauce and brown sugar with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 6 minutes until golden and cooked through, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the onion and pepper. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the mint and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Asparagus Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the oyster sauce, soy sauce and rice wine with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the shrimp for 2 minutes until pink, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the asparagus. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the shrimp to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the sesame oil and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Chicken and Cabbage Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the soy sauce, sweet chili sauce and vinegar with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until cooked through, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the cabbage and carrot. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the green onions and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Black Pepper Beef Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the oyster sauce, soy sauce and plenty of black pepper with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the beef for 2 minutes until browned, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the onion and pepper. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the beef to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the green onions and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Edamame Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the tamari, maple syrup and sesame oil with 4 tbsp water and the cornstarch.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry the edamame for 3 minutes until hot, then tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the zucchini, mushrooms and carrot. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until just tender-crisp. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the edamame to the pan, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy.
Scatter with the sesame seeds and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Jalfrezi
steps: Fry the chicken in half the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until browned, then set aside.
Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the garam masala, cumin, paprika and turmeric, then the peppers and chilies for 4 minutes and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes, water, then return the meat. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 15 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in cilantro and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Eggplant Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder, cumin and turmeric and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes, coconut milk, then the chickpeas and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 15 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in a squeeze of lemon and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Thai Green Tofu and Eggplant Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

Add coconut milk, vegetable stock, soy sauce, sugar, then the firm tofu and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 12 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in Thai basil and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Thai Red Chicken and Pumpkin Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

Add coconut milk, chicken stock, fish sauce, brown sugar, then the chicken thighs and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 15 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in lime juice and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Lamb and Spinach Curry
steps: Brown the lamb in batches in the oil and set aside.
Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the chili powder, garam masala, cumin, paprika and cardamom and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes, yogurt, water, then return the meat. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 75 minutes, covered, until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in cilantro and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash and Lentil Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, vegetable stock, then the butternut squash and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 25 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in the spinach until wilted and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Chicken Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder and flour and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

Add chicken stock, soy sauce, honey, ketchup, then the chicken thighs and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 25 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in the grated apple and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Goan-Style Fish Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the turmeric, chili, coriander and cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, tamarind, water, then the white fish and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 10 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in cilantro and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Massaman-Style Beef Curry
steps: Brown the beef in batches in the oil and set aside.
Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry paste, cinnamon and nutmeg and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

Add coconut milk, beef stock, fish sauce, tamarind, brown sugar, then return the meat. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 90 minutes, covered, until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in lime juice and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Cauliflower and Pea Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the garam masala, cumin, turmeric and chili and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes, water, then the cauliflower and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 20 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in cilantro and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Kerala-Style Shrimp Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the mustard seeds and curry leaves until they pop, then the curry powder and turmeric and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, water, tomato paste, then the shrimp and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 8 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in lime juice and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the garam masala, chili powder, cumin and kasuri methi and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

Add canned tomatoes, butter, heavy cream, sugar, then the paneer and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 15 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in cilantro and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder, allspice and thyme and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, vegetable stock, then the sweet potatoes and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 20 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in lime juice and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Malaysian-Style Chicken Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder, lemongrass paste and chili flakes and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, chicken stock, then the chicken thighs and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 30 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in lime juice and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Egg and Potato Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the garam masala, turmeric, cumin and chili and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes, water, then the eggs and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 20 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in cilantro and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Spinach Coconut Curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the onion for 6 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, tomato paste, water, then the mushrooms and the other main ingredients. Bring to a simmer and cook gently for 12 minutes until everything is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season, stir in lime juice and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Pesto Chicken and Vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 10 minutes.
Rub the chicken breasts with half the pesto and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 22 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, spoon over the rest of the pesto and scatter with parmesan.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Honey Mustard Salmon and Asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Rub the salmon fillets with the mustard mixed with the honey and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 12 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, squeeze over the lemon.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Sausage with Fennel and Grapes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 10 minutes.

Rub the italian sausages with the fennel seeds and balsamic vinegar and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 25 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Shrimp Fajitas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 12 minutes.
Rub the shrimp with the fajita seasoning and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 6 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, warm the tortillas and serve with lime wedges and sour cream.
