recipes.title: Sheet Pan Gnocchi with Tomatoes and Zucchini
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables and the gnocchi with 2 tbsp oil, the Italian seasoning and garlic, salt and pepper, and spread out on the tray in one layer.
Roast for 22 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
To finish, dot with mozzarella, return for 3 minutes and finish with basil.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chickpea Shawarma with Cauliflower
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables and the chickpeas with 2 tbsp oil, the cumin, paprika, turmeric and cinnamon, salt and pepper, and spread out on the tray in one layer.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
To finish, drizzle with tahini thinned with lemon juice and serve with warm pita.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Pork Tenderloin with Sweet Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Rub the pork tenderloin with the paprika, thyme and maple syrup and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 20 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, rest the pork 5 minutes, slice and splash the vegetables with the vinegar.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Harissa Chicken with Carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables and the chicken thighs with 2 tbsp oil, the harissa and cumin, salt and pepper, and spread out on the tray in one layer.
Roast for 40 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
To finish, serve with yogurt and mint.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Miso White Fish and Bok Choy
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 5 minutes.

Rub the white fish fillets with the miso mixed with the mirin and soy sauce and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 12 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, scatter with green onions and sesame seeds and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Steak Bites with Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 25 minutes.
Rub the steak with the garlic, rosemary and butter and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 8 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Tandoori Paneer and Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables and the paneer with 2 tbsp oil, the tandoori paste mixed with the yogurt, salt and pepper, and spread out on the tray in one layer.
Roast for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
To finish, squeeze over lemon and serve with warm naan.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Balsamic Chicken with Brussels Sprouts
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables and the chicken thighs with 2 tbsp oil, the balsamic vinegar, honey and thyme, salt and pepper, and spread out on the tray in one layer.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
To finish, scatter with parmesan.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Gochujang Tofu and Sweet Potato

ingredients.name: Firm tofu, cubed and patted dry

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Rub the firm tofu with the gochujang, maple syrup and soy sauce and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 20 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, scatter with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Mediterranean Salmon with Olives
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 10 minutes.
Rub the salmon fillets with the oregano and lemon zest and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 12 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, scatter with feta.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Smoked Sausage with Potatoes and Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Rub the smoked sausage with the paprika and garlic powder and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 15 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, serve with mustard.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Cajun Chicken and Corn
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F) and line a large baking tray.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on the tray and roast for 10 minutes.
Rub the chicken breasts with the Cajun seasoning and a little oil, then nestle it among the vegetables. Roast 22 minutes more, until it is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
To finish, rub the corn with butter and squeeze over lime.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Ragu with Rigatoni
steps: Season the beef and brown it all over in a hot pan with a little oil.
Put the beef, onion, carrots, garlic, tomatoes, tomato paste, wine and oregano in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 hours, until the meat is falling apart.
Shred the beef with two forks in the sauce. Cook the rigatoni, toss with the ragu and serve with parmesan. Leftover ragu freezes well.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken and Mushroom Stew
steps: Put the chicken, mushrooms, onion, carrots, garlic, stock, mustard and thyme in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours, until everything is tender.
Mix the cornstarch with the cream, stir into the stew and cook on HIGH for 15 minutes until thickened. Serve with mashed potatoes or bread.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lentil and Sweet Potato Stew
steps: Put everything except the spinach in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours, until everything is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season well and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Hawaiian-Style Pulled Pork
steps: Put the pork, pineapple, soy sauce, sugar, garlic and ginger in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 hours, until the meat is falling apart.
Lift out the pork, shred it and return it to the juices. Pile into the buns with some of the pineapple.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Korma
steps: Put the chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, curry paste and coconut milk in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours, until everything is tender.
Stir in the almond flour and yogurt and cook 15 minutes more on HIGH until thick. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef and Beer Stew
steps: Toss the beef in the flour and brown it in batches in a hot pan with a little oil.
Put the beef, onions, carrots, parsnips, beer, stock, Worcestershire sauce and bay leaves in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 hours, until the meat is falling apart.
Remove the bay leaves and season. Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker White Chicken Chili
steps: Put the chicken, beans, onion, garlic, chilies, stock, cumin and oregano in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours, until everything is tender.
Shred the chicken in the pot, stir in the cream cheese until melted and finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chickpea Tagine
steps: Put everything except the couscous and cilantro in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours, until everything is tender.
Pour 250 ml boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff. Serve the tagine over it with cilantro.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Chili Verde
steps: Put the pork, salsa verde, onion, garlic, cumin and stock in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 hours, until the meat is falling apart.
Shred the pork into the sauce. Serve in warm tortillas or over rice with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lamb with Rosemary and White Beans
steps: Rub the lamb with oil, salt and pepper and brown it on all sides.
Put the onion, beans, tomatoes, wine, garlic and rosemary, with the lamb on top in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 hours, until the meat is falling apart.
Pull the lamb into chunks and serve with the beans and sauce.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Put the chicken, soy sauce, honey, vinegar, garlic and ginger in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours, until everything is tender.
Lift out the chicken and shred it. Stir the cornstarch with 2 tbsp water into the sauce and cook on HIGH 10 minutes until thick, then return the chicken. Serve on rice with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Tuscan Bean Stew
steps: Put everything except the kale in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours, until everything is tender.
Stir in the kale for the last 20 minutes. Season and serve with crusty bread and olive oil.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Red Wine Short Ribs
steps: Toss the ribs in the flour and brown them well on all sides in a hot pan.
Put the ribs, onion, carrots, garlic, wine, stock, tomato paste and thyme in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours or on HIGH for 4 hours, until the meat is falling apart.
Skim the fat from the sauce, season and serve the ribs with polenta or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Mushroom Barley Stew
steps: Put everything except the dill in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours, until everything is tender.
Stir well, add a splash of water if it is very thick, and finish with dill.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Thai Peanut Chicken
steps: Put the chicken, pepper, peanut butter, coconut milk, soy sauce, honey and curry paste in the slow cooker, season with salt and pepper and stir.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5 hours or on HIGH for 3 hours, until everything is tender.
Shred the chicken, stir in the lime juice and serve on rice with chopped peanuts.

recipes.title: One-Pot Tomato Basil Spaghetti
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the spaghetti (snapped in half), tomatoes, onion, garlic and chili flakes and the vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.
Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry.
Take off the heat and stir in torn basil and an extra drizzle of olive oil. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Sausage and Spinach Rigatoni
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Brown the sausage meat in the oil for 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the rigatoni, tomatoes and garlic and the chicken stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.
Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry.
Take off the heat and stir in the spinach until wilted, then the parmesan. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Lemon Garlic Shrimp Orzo
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Melt the butter with the oil and fry the garlic and lemon zest for 1 minute.
Add the orzo and the chicken stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.

Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry. Add the shrimp for the last 3 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the lemon juice, parsley and parmesan. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Creamy Mushroom Penne
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Fry the mushrooms in the butter and oil for 5 minutes until browned, adding the garlic and thyme at the end.
Add the penne and the vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.
Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry.
Take off the heat and stir in the cream and parmesan. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Chicken Fajita Pasta
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Brown the chicken, peppers and onion in the oil for 5 minutes with the fajita seasoning.
Add the penne and tomatoes and the chicken stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.
Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry.
Take off the heat and stir in the cheese and cilantro. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Tuna and Pea Macaroni
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Soften the onion in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the macaroni and the chicken stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.

Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry. Add the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the tuna, cheese and mustard. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Black Bean Taco Pasta
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the pasta, beans, corn, tomatoes and taco seasoning and the vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.
Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry.
Take off the heat and stir in the cheese, then top each bowl with sour cream. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Broccoli Cheddar Orzo
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Fry the garlic in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the orzo and the vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.

Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry. Add the broccoli for the last 5 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the cheese and milk. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Pasta with Lentils and Tomato
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Soften the onion and carrots in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the lentils, tomatoes, rosemary and stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the macaroni. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.
Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry.
Take off the heat and stir in a drizzle of olive oil and parmesan if you like. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Chorizo and Tomato Fusilli
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Fry the chorizo for 3 minutes until it releases its oil, then add the onion for 3 minutes.
Add the fusilli, tomatoes and paprika and the chicken stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.
Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry.
Take off the heat and stir in the parsley. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Spinach Artichoke Pasta
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Fry the garlic in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the penne and the vegetable stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.
Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry.
Take off the heat and stir in the artichokes, spinach, cream cheese and parmesan until creamy. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: One-Pot Bacon and Pea Farfalle
steps: Use a wide, deep pan or casserole and heat the oil over medium heat.
Crisp the bacon in the pot for 5 minutes, then soften the onion in the fat.
Add the farfalle and the chicken stock. Bring to a boil, stirring so nothing sticks.

Simmer briskly for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has turned into a silky sauce. Add a splash of water if it gets dry. Add the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the parmesan and creme fraiche. Season and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Paprika Chicken Thighs
steps: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, sugar, 1 tsp salt and some pepper.
Rub the chicken with the oil, then the spice mix.
Air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 18 to 22 minutes, turning halfway, until the juices run clear (75°C/165°F inside).
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Coconut Shrimp
steps: Set out three bowls: flour seasoned with salt, beaten eggs, and the coconut mixed with the panko.
Dip each shrimp in flour, egg, then the coconut mix, pressing it on.
Spray the basket and the shrimp, then air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until golden.
Serve with sweet chili sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crispy Fish Fingers

ingredients.name: White fish fillets, cut into fingers

steps: Pat the fish dry and season with salt.
Coat each finger in flour, then beaten egg, then panko mixed with the paprika.
Spray with oil and air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 8 to 10 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and the fish flakes.
Serve with lemon wedges, peas and tartar sauce or ketchup.

recipes.title: Air Fryer BBQ Drumsticks
steps: Mix the sugar, paprika, garlic and onion powders and 1 tsp salt.
Toss the drumsticks in the oil and the rub.
Air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 22 to 25 minutes, turning twice, until cooked through.
Brush with BBQ sauce and air fry 2 to 3 minutes more until sticky.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.name: Bell peppers, tops cut off and seeded

steps: Mix the rice, browned beef, tomatoes and Italian seasoning and season well.
Pack the filling into the peppers.
Air fry at 180°C (350°F) for 15 minutes, top with the cheese and cook 3 minutes more until melted and the peppers are tender.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Mini Turkey Meatloaves
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, onion, thyme, Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp salt and pepper.
Shape into 4 small loaves.
Air fry at 180°C (350°F) for 12 minutes.
Mix the ketchup and sugar, brush over the loaves and cook 5 to 6 minutes more until glazed and cooked through.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Garlic Butter Steak Bites
steps: Toss the steak with the oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 7 to 9 minutes, shaking halfway, for medium.
Toss with the butter, fresh garlic and parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Parmesan
steps: Season the chicken. Coat in flour, beaten egg, then panko mixed with parmesan.
Spray and air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 10 minutes, turning once.
Spoon marinara over each piece, top with mozzarella and cook 4 to 6 minutes more until bubbling.
Serve with spaghetti or salad.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Sausages with Onions and Peppers
steps: Toss the peppers and onion with the oil and seasoning.
Air fry the sausages at 190°C (375°F) for 6 minutes, add the vegetables and cook 10 minutes more, shaking twice.
Serve the sausages in buns piled with the peppers and onions.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Pork Schnitzel
steps: Season the pork. Dip in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Spray well and air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 10 to 12 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with lemon wedges, potato salad or a green salad.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crispy Tofu Rice Bowls
steps: Toss the tofu with the tamari and sesame oil, then the cornstarch.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 13 to 15 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp.
Divide the rice between bowls, add the tofu, cucumber and carrot, and drizzle with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Lemon Pepper Salmon Bites
steps: Toss the salmon with the oil, lemon zest, pepper, garlic powder and salt.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 6 to 8 minutes, shaking once, until just cooked.
Squeeze over the lemon and serve over rice or salad.

recipes.title: Chicken Tinga Tacos
steps: Poach the chicken in salted water for 15 minutes, then shred.
Soften the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil, blend the tomatoes with the chipotles and add, then simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the chicken and simmer 5 minutes more.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven.
Fill the tortillas and finish with the toppings.

recipes.title: Al Pastor-Style Pork Tacos
steps: Mix the achiote paste, pineapple juice and cumin, coat the pork and marinate at least 20 minutes.
Sear the pork in batches in a very hot pan with 1 tbsp oil until charred at the edges, then chop.
Sear the pineapple until caramelised.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven.
Fill the tortillas and finish with the toppings.

recipes.title: Crispy Black Bean Tacos
steps: Mash the beans roughly with the cumin, chili powder and salt.
Spread beans and cheese on half of each tortilla and fold.
Fry in a lightly oiled pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp.
Open each taco slightly and tuck in the toppings.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Poblano Tacos
steps: Char the poblanos and onion in 1 tbsp oil in a hot pan for 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook 8 minutes until browned, then season with cumin, oregano and salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven.
Fill the tortillas and finish with the toppings.

recipes.title: Ground Turkey Tacos
steps: Brown the turkey and onion in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes.
Stir in the taco seasoning and tomato sauce and simmer 4 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven.
Fill the tortillas and finish with the toppings.

recipes.title: Carne Asada Tacos
steps: Marinate the steak with the juice of 1 lime, garlic, cumin, half the cilantro, 2 tbsp oil and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Grill or sear in a very hot pan 4 to 5 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thinly across the grain.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven.
Fill the tortillas and finish with the toppings.

recipes.title: Lentil Walnut Tacos
steps: Simmer the lentils in water for 20 minutes until tender, then drain.
Fry the onion in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, add the walnuts for 2 minutes, then the lentils, taco seasoning and a splash of water, and cook until thick.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven.
Fill the tortillas and finish with the toppings.

recipes.title: Korean BBQ Beef Tacos
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and gochujang and toss with the beef for 15 minutes.
Sear in a very hot pan in batches for 2 minutes until caramelised.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven.
Fill the tortillas and finish with the toppings.

recipes.title: Chipotle Salmon Tacos
steps: Mix the chipotle, honey, lime juice and salt and brush over the salmon.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 10 to 12 minutes, then flake.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven.
Fill the tortillas and finish with the toppings.

recipes.title: Chorizo and Potato Tacos
steps: Boil the potatoes for 5 minutes and drain.
Fry the chorizo for 3 minutes, add the onion and potatoes and cook 12 minutes until the potatoes are crisp.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven.
Fill the tortillas and finish with the toppings.

recipes.title: Nasi Goreng
steps: Fry the shallots, garlic and chili in the oil for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and stir-fry 4 minutes until cooked.
Add the rice, kecap manis and soy sauce and stir-fry over high heat 4 minutes until hot and lightly caramelised.
Fry the eggs separately and serve one on each plate with cucumber slices.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Fried Rice
steps: Fry the garlic and chilies in the oil for 30 seconds.
Add the pork and cook, breaking it up, for 4 minutes.
Add the rice, fish sauce, oyster sauce and sugar and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Toss in the basil until just wilted and serve.

recipes.title: Bacon and Cabbage Fried Rice
steps: Cook the bacon in a large pan until crisp.
Add the cabbage and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Push to one side, scramble the eggs in the gap, then stir together.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry until hot. Finish with sesame oil and green onions.

recipes.title: Tofu and Broccoli Fried Rice
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic and broccoli and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add the rice and tamari and stir-fry until hot.
Finish with green onions.

recipes.title: Garlic Chili Oil Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and divide between bowls.
Put the garlic, chili flakes, sesame seeds and green onions on top.
Heat the oil until shimmering and carefully pour it over to sizzle.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar and sugar, toss and serve.

recipes.title: Beef Chow Fun-Style Noodles
steps: Soak or cook the noodles as the packet says and drain.
Toss the beef with the cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Sear the beef in the hot oil for 2 minutes and remove.
Stir-fry the noodles with the remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar until coloured, then add the beef, bean sprouts and green onions for 1 minute.

recipes.title: Sesame Chicken Ramen Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the noodles for 2 minutes and drain.
Stir-fry the chicken in the sesame oil for 5 minutes.
Add the carrot and snow peas for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and honey and toss until glossy. Finish with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Cumin Lamb Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Sear the lamb in the hot oil for 3 minutes, then add the cumin seeds and chili flakes for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and garlic and stir-fry 2 minutes.
Toss in the noodles and soy sauce and finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken and Broccoli Rice Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and grease a 23 x 33 cm baking dish.
Stir the rice, stock, milk, onion, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and pepper together in the dish, then scatter over the chicken.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 35 minutes.
Stir in the broccoli and half the cheese, top with the rest and bake uncovered 10 to 15 minutes until the rice is tender and the top is golden.

recipes.title: Beef Enchilada Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Brown the beef and onion, then stir in the beans, taco seasoning and half the enchilada sauce.
Layer a third of the tortillas in a baking dish, then half the beef and a third of the cheese. Repeat, finish with tortillas, the remaining sauce and cheese.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until bubbling. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Brown the beef with the onion, season, and spread in a baking dish.
Mix the soup and milk and pour over, then scatter over the green beans and cheese.
Cover with the tater tots in a neat layer and bake 35 to 40 minutes until the tots are crisp.

recipes.title: Baked Penne with Sausage and Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cook the penne 3 minutes less than the packet says and drain.
Brown the sausage, then soften the peppers and onion in the same pan.
Mix everything with the marinara and half the mozzarella in a baking dish.
Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan and bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cook the rigatoni until just short of tender and drain.
Mix the pasta, chicken, marinara and half the mozzarella in a baking dish.
Top with the rest of the mozzarella. Mix the panko, parmesan, oil and seasoning and scatter over.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Turkey and Sweet Potato Cottage Pie
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes for 12 minutes until soft, drain and mash with the butter and salt.
Brown the turkey with the onion and carrots, then stir in the tomato paste, stock and Worcestershire sauce and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the peas.
Spoon into a baking dish, top with the mash and rough up the surface.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling at the edges.

recipes.title: Spinach and Mushroom Lasagne
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Fry the mushrooms in the oil until browned, add the garlic and spinach and cook until wilted, then squeeze out excess liquid.
Mix the ricotta with the egg, half the parmesan and salt.
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta, vegetables and mozzarella in a baking dish three times, finishing with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes, uncover and bake 15 minutes more. Rest 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and cook the noodles until just tender.
Mix the soup and milk, then fold in the noodles, tuna, peas and most of the cheese.
Spread in a baking dish, top with the remaining cheese and the breadcrumbs mixed with butter.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Mexican Rice and Bean Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Stir the rice, beans, corn, salsa, stock and cumin together in a baking dish.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 40 minutes until the rice is tender.
Scatter over the cheese and bake uncovered 5 minutes more. Finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potato and Ham Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a baking dish.
Warm the cream, milk and garlic with 1 tsp salt and pepper.
Layer the potatoes, ham, onion and cheese, finishing with potatoes and cheese, then pour over the cream.
Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes, uncover and bake 15 minutes more until tender and golden.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Cod with Lemon Caper Butter
steps: Pat the fish dry, season and dust with flour.
Sear in the oil 3 to 4 minutes a side until golden and just flaking.
Remove the fish, add the butter and capers and cook until the butter is nutty brown.
Add the lemon juice and parsley and spoon over the fish.

recipes.title: Chicken Thighs in Creamy Mustard Sauce
steps: Season the chicken and brown well in the oil, 5 minutes a side; remove.
Soften the shallots in the pan, add the wine and boil until reduced by half.
Stir in the cream and mustard and return the chicken. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes until cooked through.
Finish with tarragon.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Pork Chops
steps: Season the chops and sear in the oil 4 to 5 minutes a side until browned and cooked to 63°C (145°F); rest on a plate.
Lower the heat, add the butter and garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the honey, soy sauce and vinegar and bubble 2 minutes until syrupy.
Return the chops and turn them in the glaze.

recipes.title: Sesame-Crusted Tuna Steaks
steps: Season the tuna lightly and press the sesame seeds onto both sides.
Sear in a very hot pan with the oil for 1 to 2 minutes a side, leaving the middle pink.
Mix the soy sauce, vinegar and ginger.
Slice the tuna and serve with the dipping sauce and green onion, with rice or salad.

recipes.title: Turkey Cutlets with Sage Butter

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 4 thin cutlets

steps: Season the cutlets and dust with flour.
Fry in the oil 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked through; keep warm.
Add the butter and sage to the pan and cook until the sage is crisp and the butter is golden.
Squeeze in a little lemon and pour over the turkey.

recipes.title: Steak with Peppercorn Sauce
steps: Season the steaks with salt and press the crushed peppercorns into one side.
Sear in the hot oil 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare, then rest.
Soften the shallot in the butter, add the brandy and let it bubble away.
Add the stock and boil 2 minutes, then the cream, and simmer until it coats a spoon. Serve over the steaks.

recipes.title: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Chicken
steps: Season the chicken and sear in the oil 5 to 6 minutes a side until cooked through; remove.
Fry the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Add the cream, stock, seasoning and parmesan and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in the spinach, return the chicken and spoon the sauce over.

recipes.title: Cajun Blackened White Fish
steps: Mix the Cajun seasoning, paprika and thyme.
Brush the fish with the melted butter and coat in the spices.
Cook in a very hot cast-iron pan with the oil 3 to 4 minutes a side until blackened and flaky (open a window).
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Salmon with Dill Yogurt
steps: Mix the yogurt, dill, garlic, a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Season the salmon and cook skin side down in the oil for 5 minutes until crisp, then turn for 2 to 3 minutes.
Serve with the dill yogurt and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Pork Medallions with Cider Sauce
steps: Season the pork and sear in the oil 2 to 3 minutes a side; remove.
Fry the apple and shallot in the butter for 3 minutes.
Add the apple juice and boil until reduced by half, then stir in the cream and mustard.
Return the pork for 2 minutes to finish cooking.

recipes.title: Chicken Milanese with Arugula

ingredients.name: Chicken breasts, halved and pounded thin

steps: Coat the chicken in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan.
Shallow-fry in the oil 3 minutes a side until golden and cooked; drain.
Toss the arugula and tomatoes with lemon juice, olive oil and salt.
Serve the chicken topped with the salad and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Trout Amandine
steps: Season the trout and dust with flour.
Fry in 1 tbsp butter 2 to 3 minutes a side; plate.
Add the rest of the butter and the almonds and cook until golden.
Add lemon juice and parsley and spoon over the fish.

recipes.title: Greek Shrimp Saganaki
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and chili and simmer 8 minutes.
Nestle in the shrimp, scatter over the feta and cook covered 4 minutes until the shrimp are pink.
Finish with parsley and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Tofu Steaks with Ginger Glaze

ingredients.name: Firm tofu, cut into 4 slabs and pressed

steps: Pat the tofu dry and dust with cornstarch.
Fry in the oil 4 to 5 minutes a side until crisp.
Mix the tamari, maple syrup, ginger and vinegar, pour into the pan and let it bubble and coat the tofu.
Scatter with green onion and serve with rice and greens.

recipes.title: Chicken Paprikash
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and remove.
Cook the onions and pepper gently for 8 minutes, then stir in the paprika and tomato paste off the heat.
Add the stock and chicken, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Mix the sour cream with the flour, stir in and heat gently without boiling. Serve over egg noodles.

recipes.title: Bratwurst with Sauerkraut and Potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes.
Brown the bratwurst in the oil for 10 minutes, turning.
In the same pan soften the onion, then add the sauerkraut, apple, caraway and a splash of water and heat through for 5 minutes.
Serve the sausages on the sauerkraut with the potatoes and mustard.

recipes.title: Duck Breast with Cherry Sauce
steps: Score the duck skin and season.
Put skin side down in a cold pan, then cook over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes until the fat renders and the skin is crisp. Turn and cook 3 to 4 minutes for pink, then rest.
Pour off most of the fat, add the cherries, wine, honey, vinegar and thyme and simmer until syrupy.
Slice the duck and spoon over the sauce.

recipes.title: Lamb and Feta Burgers
steps: Mix the lamb, feta, oregano, garlic and pepper and shape into 4 patties.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan or on the grill 4 to 5 minutes a side until cooked through.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with the toppings.

recipes.title: Salmon Burgers with Lemon Mayo

ingredients.name: Salmon fillet, skinned and finely chopped

steps: Mix the salmon, panko, egg, green onions, lemon zest and salt and shape into 4 patties. Chill 15 minutes.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan or on the grill 3 to 4 minutes a side until cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise with a squeeze of the zested lemon.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with the toppings.

recipes.title: Smoky Chickpea Burgers
steps: Mash the chickpeas roughly, mix in the breadcrumbs, egg, paprika, cumin, carrot and salt, and shape into 4 patties.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan or on the grill 4 to 5 minutes a side until cooked through.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with the toppings.

recipes.title: Mushroom Swiss Burgers
steps: Shape the beef into 4 patties slightly wider than the buns and season well. Fry the mushrooms in the butter until golden and set aside.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan or on the grill 4 to 5 minutes a side until cooked through (71°C/160°F for beef, 74°C/165°F for poultry).
Top with the mushrooms and cheese, cover for 1 minute to melt.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with the toppings.

recipes.title: Chicken Burgers with Pesto Mayo
steps: Mix the chicken, parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic and salt and shape into 4 patties with wet hands.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan or on the grill 5 to 6 minutes a side until cooked through (71°C/160°F for beef, 74°C/165°F for poultry).
Mix the pesto with the mayonnaise.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with the toppings.

recipes.title: Halloumi Burgers with Roasted Peppers
steps: Pat the halloumi dry and sprinkle with oregano.
Fry the halloumi in a dry pan 2 minutes a side until golden.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with the toppings.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Pineapple Turkey Burgers
steps: Mix the turkey with 1 tbsp teriyaki sauce, the green onions and pepper and shape into 4 patties.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan or on the grill 5 to 6 minutes a side until cooked through (71°C/160°F for beef, 74°C/165°F for poultry).
Brush with the rest of the teriyaki sauce and grill the pineapple rings 2 minutes a side.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with the toppings.

recipes.title: Smash Burgers
steps: Divide the beef into 8 loose balls.
Heat a heavy pan or griddle until very hot.
Put in 2 balls at a time, cover with onion slices and smash flat with a sturdy spatula. Season and cook 2 minutes until deeply browned, then flip.
Add cheese, stack two patties per burger and cook 1 minute more.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with the toppings.

recipes.title: Lemon Asparagus Risotto
steps: Keep the stock hot in a pan. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir 1 minute until glossy, then add the wine and let it bubble away.

Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each is absorbed, for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy but still has a little bite. Add the asparagus for the last 5 minutes.
Off the heat, beat in the butter, parmesan and the lemon zest and juice. Season, cover for 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Tomato and Mozzarella Risotto
steps: Keep the stock hot in a pan. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir 1 minute until glossy, then add the wine and let it bubble away.

Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each is absorbed, for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy but still has a little bite. Stir the tomato paste in with the rice and add the cherry tomatoes halfway.
Off the heat, beat in the butter, parmesan and the mozzarella and torn basil. Season, cover for 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Lemon Risotto
steps: Keep the stock hot in a pan. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir 1 minute until glossy, then add the wine and let it bubble away.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each is absorbed, for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy but still has a little bite. Add the shrimp for the last 4 minutes.
Off the heat, beat in the butter, parmesan and the lemon and parsley. Season, cover for 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Spinach and Blue Cheese Risotto
steps: Keep the stock hot in a pan. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir 1 minute until glossy, then add the wine and let it bubble away.

Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each is absorbed, for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy but still has a little bite. Stir in the spinach for the last 2 minutes.
Off the heat, beat in the butter, parmesan and the blue cheese, with walnuts on top. Season, cover for 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Beet Risotto with Goat Cheese
steps: Keep the stock hot in a pan. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir 1 minute until glossy, then add the wine and let it bubble away.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each is absorbed, for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy but still has a little bite. Stir in the beets halfway through.
Off the heat, beat in the butter, parmesan and half the goat cheese, crumbling the rest on top with the dill. Season, cover for 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken and Leek Risotto
steps: Keep the stock hot in a pan. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir 1 minute until glossy, then add the wine and let it bubble away.

Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each is absorbed, for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy but still has a little bite. Brown the chicken first and set aside; soften the leeks with the onion and return the chicken halfway.
Off the heat, beat in the butter, parmesan and the thyme. Season, cover for 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Saffron Risotto
steps: Keep the stock hot in a pan. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir 1 minute until glossy, then add the wine and let it bubble away.

Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each is absorbed, for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy but still has a little bite. Soak the saffron in a ladle of hot stock and add it with the first stock.
Off the heat, beat in the butter, parmesan and a little extra parmesan. Season, cover for 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Moong Dal with Spinach
steps: Simmer the dal with the water, turmeric and salt for 25 minutes until soft.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Heat the ghee, fry the cumin seeds, garlic and chili until fragrant, add the tomato for 2 minutes and pour over the dal.
Serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.title: Sambar-Style Lentils with Vegetables
steps: Simmer the dal with the water and turmeric for 25 minutes until soft, then mash.
Add the vegetables, onion, sambar powder, tamarind and salt and simmer 10 to 12 minutes until tender.
Heat the oil, fry the mustard seeds until they pop, add the curry leaves and pour over.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Rajma (Kidney Bean Curry)
steps: Fry the cumin seeds in the oil, then the onion for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and cook 8 minutes until thick.
Add the beans and 300 ml water, mash a few beans to thicken and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: West African Black-Eyed Pea Stew
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes with the scotch bonnet.
Add the tomato paste and paprika for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, stock and sweet potato.
Simmer 15 minutes, then add the peas and cook 8 minutes more until thick.
Serve with rice or fried plantains.

recipes.title: Ful Medames
steps: Warm the beans with their liquid for 10 minutes and mash about half.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, lemon juice and salt.
Spoon into bowls, pour over the olive oil and top with tomato and parsley.
Serve with warm pita.

recipes.title: Cuban-Style Black Beans and Rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Make a sofrito: soften the onion, pepper and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the beans with their liquid, cumin, oregano and bay leaf and simmer 15 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken.
Stir in the vinegar, season and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Feijoada-Style Black Bean Stew
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp, then brown the pork and sausage in the fat.
Add the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the beans, stock and bay leaves and simmer gently for 40 minutes until the pork is tender and the stew thick.
Serve with rice and orange slices.

recipes.title: Tuscan White Beans with Kale
steps: Warm the garlic, chili and rosemary in the oil until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes, then the beans and kale with a splash of water.
Cover and cook 10 minutes until the kale is tender.
Serve with parmesan and toasted bread.

recipes.title: Ethiopian-Style Red Lentil Stew
steps: Cook the onions slowly in the oil for 10 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, berbere and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Add the lentils and water and simmer 20 minutes, stirring, until thick and soft.
Season and serve with flatbread or rice.

recipes.title: Dal Makhani-Style Black Lentils
steps: Simmer the soaked lentils in plenty of water for 45 minutes until very soft; drain, keeping some liquid.
Cook the onion in the butter for 8 minutes, add the ginger garlic paste and spices, then the tomatoes for 8 minutes.
Add the lentils, beans and 400 ml of their liquid and simmer 15 minutes, stirring and mashing a little.
Stir in the cream and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
steps: Melt or heat the butter in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the garlic and nutmeg and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in the milk, and scatter with chives.

recipes.title: Curried Parsnip Soup
steps: Melt or heat the olive oil in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the curry powder and ginger and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in the coconut milk.

recipes.title: Pea and Mint Soup
steps: Melt or heat the butter in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the garlic and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 12 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in the mint (blend it in), and swirl over creme fraiche.

recipes.title: Spiced Pumpkin Soup
steps: Melt or heat the butter in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the cumin, cinnamon and nutmeg and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 25 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in the cream, and top with toasted pumpkin seeds.

recipes.title: Zucchini Basil Soup
steps: Melt or heat the olive oil in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the garlic and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in the basil (blend it in), and top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Watercress and Potato Soup
steps: Melt or heat the butter in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the garlic and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 18 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in the cream (add the watercress for the last 2 minutes before blending so it stays green).

recipes.title: Cream of Asparagus Soup
steps: Melt or heat the butter in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the garlic and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the chicken stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in the cream and a squeeze of lemon, and garnish with the blanched tips.

recipes.title: Beet and Apple Soup with Dill
steps: Melt or heat the olive oil in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the caraway and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in the vinegar, and top with sour cream and dill.

recipes.title: Sweet Corn Soup with Chili
steps: Melt or heat the butter in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the jalapeno and cumin and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in lime juice, and top with cilantro and a few reserved corn kernels.

recipes.title: Spinach and Potato Soup
steps: Melt or heat the butter in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the garlic and nutmeg and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 18 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in the milk (add the spinach for the last minute before blending).

recipes.title: Smoky Tomato and Chipotle Soup
steps: Melt or heat the olive oil in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the chipotle, paprika and garlic and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently, ladle into bowls and top with sour cream and crushed tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Green Broccoli and Spinach Soup
steps: Melt or heat the olive oil in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the garlic and ginger and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 12 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in a squeeze of lemon, and top with pumpkin seeds.

recipes.title: Red Pepper and Sweet Potato Soup
steps: Melt or heat the olive oil in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the paprika and cumin and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently, ladle into bowls and swirl in the yogurt.

recipes.title: Cream of Celery Soup
steps: Melt or heat the butter in a large pot and soften the onion gently for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and the garlic and thyme and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the chicken stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 25 minutes until everything is very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or in batches in a blender, venting the lid). Season to taste.
Reheat gently and stir in the cream.

recipes.title: White Bean and Rosemary Soup
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and rosemary for 1 minute.
Add the beans and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Remove the rosemary and blend about half the soup, leaving the rest chunky.
Season, add a squeeze of lemon and serve with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Tuscan Sausage, Potato and Kale Soup
steps: Brown the sausage meat in a large pot, breaking it up, then add the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, stock and chili flakes and simmer 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the kale and cream and simmer 5 minutes more.
Season and serve.

recipes.title: Lemony Lentil and Spinach Soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrots in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and cumin.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Add the juice of the lemon, season and serve.

recipes.title: Mulligatawny Soup
steps: Fry the onion, carrots and apple in the oil for 6 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder for 1 minute, then add the chicken, lentils and stock.
Simmer 25 minutes, then lift out the chicken, blend the soup until fairly smooth and return the chicken.
Stir in the coconut milk and rice and heat through.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Pea and Collard Soup
steps: Cook the bacon in a large pot until crisp, then soften the onion and celery in the fat.
Add the garlic, peas, tomatoes and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the collards and simmer 15 minutes more until tender.
Season with hot sauce and salt.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion, then stir in the taco seasoning.
Add the beans, tomatoes, corn and stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Serve topped with cheddar and sour cream, with tortilla chips if you like.

recipes.title: Cabbage Roll Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic.
Add the cabbage, tomatoes, stock, rice, paprika, sugar and vinegar.
Simmer 30 minutes until the cabbage and rice are soft.
Season and serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Hungarian Goulash Soup
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches, then soften the onions in the same pot for 8 minutes.
Off the heat stir in the paprika, caraway and tomato paste, then return the beef and add the stock.
Cover and simmer 1 hour.
Add the peppers and potatoes and simmer 25 minutes more until the beef is tender.

recipes.title: Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery in the butter for 6 minutes, then stir in the flour.
Add the wild rice, stock, thyme and whole chicken breasts and simmer 45 minutes until the rice is tender.
Shred the chicken back into the pot.
Stir in the cream, season and heat through.

recipes.title: Caldo Verde-Style Kale and Chorizo Soup
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the potatoes and stock and simmer 20 minutes until soft.
Mash or blend until fairly smooth.
Fry the chorizo in a separate pan until crisp.
Add the kale to the soup and simmer 5 minutes, then stir in the chorizo and its oil.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pepper Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion, then add the peppers and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, stock, rice and seasoning.
Simmer 20 minutes until the rice is tender.
Serve topped with cheese.

recipes.title: Lasagna Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic, then stir in the tomato paste.
Add the tomatoes, stock and seasoning and bring to a boil.
Add the broken noodles and simmer 12 to 15 minutes until tender.
Serve topped with spoonfuls of ricotta and mozzarella.

recipes.title: Chickpea Noodle Soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, thyme and stock and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and noodles and cook until the noodles are tender.
Season and finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Udon Soup
steps: Simmer the stock, soy sauce, mirin and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and simmer 8 minutes until cooked.
Add the noodles and bok choy and cook 3 minutes.
Ladle into bowls and top with green onions.

recipes.title: Laksa-Style Coconut Noodle Soup
steps: Fry the laksa paste in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the stock, coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar and simmer 10 minutes.
Cook the noodles separately and divide between bowls.
Poach the shrimp in the soup for 3 minutes, then ladle over the noodles and top with bean sprouts, cilantro and lime.

recipes.title: Ginger Chicken Rice Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer the stock with the ginger, onion and fish sauce for 10 minutes.
Poach the chicken in it for 12 minutes, then lift out and shred.
Cook the noodles, divide between bowls and add the chicken.
Strain the broth over and top with bean sprouts, basil, chili and lime.

recipes.title: Spicy Kimchi Noodle Soup
steps: Fry the kimchi in the sesame oil for 2 minutes, then stir in the gochujang.
Add the stock and soy sauce and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the tofu and noodles and cook 3 minutes, cracking in the eggs to poach for the last 2 minutes.
Top with green onions.

recipes.title: Tofu and Bok Choy Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer the stock with the soy sauce, ginger and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu and bok choy and simmer 4 minutes.
Cook the noodles separately, then divide between bowls.
Ladle over the soup and finish with sesame oil and green onions.

recipes.title: Chicken Pho-Style Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer the stock with the charred onion and ginger, star anise and cinnamon for 25 minutes, then strain.
Add the fish sauce and poach the chicken for 12 minutes; slice it.
Cook the noodles and divide between bowls with the chicken.
Pour over the hot broth and serve with bean sprouts, basil and lime.

recipes.title: Sopa de Fideo
steps: Toast the vermicelli in the oil, stirring, until golden brown.
Blend the tomatoes, onion and garlic and pour into the pot (it will splutter), cooking 3 minutes.
Add the stock and cumin and simmer 10 minutes until the noodles are soft.
Season and serve with cilantro and lime.

recipes.title: Chinese Tomato and Egg Soup
steps: Fry the tomatoes in the oil for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the stock, soy sauce and sugar and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water to thicken slightly.
Drizzle in the eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons, then add the sesame oil and green onions.

recipes.title: Salmon Chowder
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the butter for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer 12 minutes until tender.
Add the milk, corn and salmon and simmer gently 5 minutes until the fish is just cooked.
Season and finish with dill.

recipes.title: Fish Chowder
steps: Crisp the bacon in a pot, then soften the onion in the fat.
Add the potatoes, thyme and stock and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the milk, cream and fish and simmer very gently 5 minutes.
Season and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Corn Chowder
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the butter, then stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Gradually add the stock, then the potatoes, and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the corn, chicken and milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Mash a few potatoes against the side to thicken and season.

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
steps: Crisp the bacon and set aside, keeping 1 tbsp fat in the pot.
Soften the onion, add the potatoes and stock and simmer 15 minutes until very soft.
Mash roughly, then stir in the milk, sour cream and most of the cheese.
Serve topped with bacon, the rest of the cheese and green onions.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Corn Chowder
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the butter with the seafood seasoning.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the corn and milk and blend a third of the soup to thicken.
Add the shrimp and simmer 3 minutes until pink.

recipes.title: Chilled Cucumber Yogurt Soup
steps: Blend the cucumbers, yogurt, garlic, most of the herbs and half the lemon juice until smooth.
Season and add cold water to thin if needed.
Chill at least 1 hour.
Serve with olive oil and the remaining herbs.

recipes.title: Watermelon Gazpacho
steps: Blend the watermelon, tomatoes, three quarters of the cucumber, a little of the onion and the jalapeno until smooth.
Season with the vinegar, oil and salt.
Chill at least 1 hour.
Serve topped with the rest of the cucumber, diced, and mint.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Orzo Salad
steps: Cook the orzo in salted boiling water for about 9 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together the olive oil, vinegar and oregano with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled orzo with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Couscous Salad
steps: Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over boiling water to cover by 1 cm, cover and leave 10 minutes (15 for bulgur), then fluff with a fork.
Whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice and cumin with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled couscous with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Wild Rice and Cranberry Salad
steps: Cook the wild rice in salted boiling water for about 45 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together the olive oil, cider vinegar and maple syrup with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled wild rice with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Pearl Barley Salad with Roasted Squash
steps: Cook the barley in salted boiling water for about 30 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together the olive oil, balsamic and mustard with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled barley with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Southwest Quinoa Salad
steps: Cook the quinoa in salted boiling water for about 15 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together the olive oil, lime, cumin and chili powder with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled quinoa with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Sesame Soba and Edamame Salad
steps: Cook the soba noodles in salted boiling water for about 5 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil and honey with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled soba noodles with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Pesto Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the fusilli in salted boiling water for about 10 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together the pesto, olive oil and lemon juice with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled fusilli with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Greek Lentil and Bulgur Salad
steps: Put the bulgur in a bowl, pour over boiling water to cover by 1 cm, cover and leave 10 minutes (15 for bulgur), then fluff with a fork.
Whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice and oregano with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled bulgur with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Farro Salad with Apples and Cheddar
steps: Cook the farro in salted boiling water for about 25 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together the olive oil, cider vinegar, mustard and honey with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled farro with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Brown Rice and Tuna Salad
steps: Cook the brown rice in salted boiling water for about 30 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice and mustard with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled brown rice with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: Cook the macaroni in salted boiling water for about 9 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar and paprika with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled macaroni with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Freekeh Salad with Herbs and Pomegranate
steps: Cook the freekeh in salted boiling water for about 25 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together the olive oil, pomegranate molasses and lemon with salt and pepper.
Toss the cooled freekeh with everything else and the dressing.
Taste for seasoning. It keeps well in the fridge for 2 to 3 days, so it is good for packed lunches.

recipes.title: Arugula, Pear and Parmesan Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Toss the arugula and pears with the dressing.
Scatter with the parmesan and walnuts and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Spinach Strawberry Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar and honey with a pinch of salt.
Toss the spinach and strawberries with the dressing.
Top with crumbled goat cheese and almonds.

recipes.title: Shaved Fennel and Orange Salad
steps: Toss the fennel and onion with the lemon juice and salt and leave 5 minutes to soften.
Add the orange segments and olives.
Drizzle with the oil and serve.

recipes.title: Simple Green Salad with Dijon Dressing

ingredients.name: Lettuce, such as butter lettuce, leaves torn

steps: Whisk the mustard, vinegar, shallot, salt and pepper, then whisk in the oil.
Toss the lettuce and cucumber with just enough dressing to coat, right before serving.

recipes.title: Chopped Italian Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Chop everything to a similar small size and combine in a large bowl.
Toss with the dressing and serve.

recipes.title: Kale Salad with Apple and Cranberry
steps: Massage the kale with the lemon juice, oil and a pinch of salt for 2 minutes until it softens and darkens.
Add the maple syrup, apple, cranberries and seeds and toss.
It keeps dressed for a day in the fridge.

recipes.title: Thai Cucumber Peanut Salad
steps: Stir the lime juice, fish sauce and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Toss with the cucumber, onion and chili.
Top with peanuts and cilantro and serve within an hour.

recipes.title: Mexican Street Corn Salad
steps: Char the corn in the butter in a hot pan for 6 to 8 minutes, then cool slightly.
Mix the mayonnaise, sour cream, lime juice and chili powder.
Toss with the corn, jalapeno and cilantro and top with the cheese.

recipes.title: Tomato and Cucumber Salad
steps: Combine the tomatoes, cucumbers, onion and parsley.
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, sumac and salt just before serving.

recipes.title: Broccoli Crunch Salad
steps: Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar and honey with a pinch of salt.
Toss with the broccoli, onion, cranberries and seeds.
Chill 30 minutes, then top with the bacon.

recipes.title: Roasted Beet and Orange Salad
steps: Wrap the beets in foil and roast at 200°C (400°F) for 45 minutes until tender, then peel and slice.
Arrange with the orange slices and arugula.
Drizzle with oil and vinegar, season and top with feta and pistachios.

recipes.title: Asian Sesame Chicken Salad
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and honey.
Toss the cabbage, carrot, pepper, green onions and chicken with the dressing.
Scatter with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad with Grapes and Celery
steps: Mix the mayonnaise, yogurt, mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Fold in the chicken, grapes, celery and pecans.
Serve on lettuce or in sandwiches.

recipes.title: Steak Salad with Blue Cheese
steps: Season the steak and sear 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare; rest 5 minutes and slice.
Toss the lettuce, tomatoes and onion with the oil and vinegar.
Top with the steak and blue cheese.

recipes.title: Salmon Salad with Avocado
steps: Season the salmon and roast at 200°C (400°F) for 12 minutes, then flake.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice and mustard.
Toss the greens and cucumber with half the dressing, top with the salmon and avocado and drizzle with the rest.

recipes.title: Halloumi and Watermelon Salad
steps: Fry the halloumi in a dry pan 2 minutes a side until golden.
Toss the watermelon, cucumber and mint with the oil and lime juice.
Top with the warm halloumi.

recipes.title: Edamame and Corn Salad
steps: Blanch the edamame and corn for 3 minutes, then cool under cold water.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, honey and salt.
Toss everything together.

recipes.title: Moroccan Carrot Salad
steps: Boil the carrots 4 to 5 minutes until just tender, then drain.
While warm, toss with the oil, spices, lemon juice, garlic and salt.
Cool, then stir in the parsley.

recipes.title: Italian Bean Salad with Tuna
steps: Soak the onion in the vinegar with a pinch of salt for 5 minutes to soften it.
Add the beans, tuna, parsley and oil and toss gently.
Season well and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Creamy Cucumber Dill Salad
steps: Salt the cucumbers and leave 10 minutes, then squeeze out the liquid.
Mix the sour cream, vinegar, dill and sugar.
Fold in the cucumbers and onion and chill.

recipes.title: Red Cabbage and Apple Slaw
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, honey, mustard and salt.
Toss with the cabbage, apples and carrot.
Leave 15 minutes to soften slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Creamy Broccoli Slaw

ingredients.name: Broccoli, stems peeled and cut into matchsticks (or bagged broccoli slaw)

steps: Mix the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Toss with the broccoli, carrot and raisins.
Chill 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mango Jicama Slaw
steps: Whisk the lime juice, oil, chili powder and salt.
Toss with the mango, jicama, cabbage and cilantro.
Serve with tacos, grilled fish or chicken.

recipes.title: Peanut Ginger Slaw
steps: Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey and ginger with 2 tbsp warm water.
Toss with the vegetables.
Top with peanuts.

recipes.title: Vinegar Coleslaw
steps: Warm the vinegar, oil, sugar, celery seed and 1 tsp salt until the sugar dissolves.
Pour over the cabbage, carrot and onion and toss.
Chill at least 1 hour, tossing once; it gets better overnight.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad with Honey Lime
steps: Whisk the honey with the lime zest and juice.
Toss gently with the fruit.
Scatter with mint and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Warm Lentil Salad with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Roast the onion, peppers and zucchini with 1 tbsp oil at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes.
Simmer the lentils in water 20 to 25 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Whisk the remaining oil with the vinegar and mustard and toss with the warm lentils and vegetables.
Top with goat cheese.

recipes.title: Potato Salad with Herbs and Mustard
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water 15 minutes until tender, drain and halve.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Toss the warm potatoes with the dressing and onion so they soak it up.
Stir in the herbs when cooled.

recipes.title: Parmesan Roasted Zucchini
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, garlic powder and Italian seasoning, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 20 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, sprinkle with parmesan for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Maple Roasted Butternut Squash
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, maple syrup and cinnamon, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 35 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, scatter with pecans.

recipes.title: Roasted Green Beans with Almonds
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, garlic, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 15 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, toss with the toasted almonds and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Smoky Roasted Cauliflower
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, smoked paprika and cumin, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 25 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Roasted Asparagus with Parmesan
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, garlic, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 12 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, top with parmesan and lemon zest.

recipes.title: Balsamic Roasted Beets

ingredients.name: Beets, peeled and cut into wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, balsamic vinegar and thyme, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 40 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, top with feta if you like.

recipes.title: Crispy Roasted Potatoes with Rosemary
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, rosemary and garlic, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 45 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, finish with flaky salt and parsley (parboiling the potatoes for 8 minutes first and roughing them up makes them extra crisp).

recipes.title: Roasted Carrots and Parsnips with Honey
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, thyme (add the honey for the last 10 minutes), salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 35 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Garlic Roasted Mushrooms and Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, garlic and oregano, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 20 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, splash with balsamic.

recipes.title: Spiced Roasted Sweet Potato Cubes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, cumin, paprika and chili, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, squeeze over lime.

recipes.title: Roasted Broccolini with Chili and Lemon
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, chili flakes and garlic, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 15 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Za'atar Roasted Carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, za'atar, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, serve over a swoosh of yogurt.

recipes.title: Roasted Eggplant with Yogurt and Mint
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, cumin, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, top with garlicky yogurt and mint.

recipes.title: Roasted Radishes with Butter
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, thyme, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 20 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, toss with butter and chives.

recipes.title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, chopped bacon, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 25 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, drizzle with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Roasted Cabbage Wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan, 425°F).
Toss the vegetables with the oil, caraway and garlic powder, salt and pepper and spread out on a baking tray in one layer, with space between the pieces.
Roast for about 30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.
To finish, splash with vinegar.

recipes.title: Garlic Mashed Cauliflower
steps: Boil the cauliflower and garlic in salted water 12 to 15 minutes until very soft.
Drain well and let steam dry for 2 minutes.
Mash or blend with the butter, parmesan and milk until smooth, then season.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Mash with Brown Butter
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes 15 minutes until soft and drain.
Cook the butter in a small pan until it smells nutty and turns golden brown.
Mash the potatoes with the butter, nutmeg and salt.

recipes.title: Colcannon
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 to 20 minutes until tender and drain.
