Meanwhile soften the cabbage in 1 tbsp butter for 5 minutes, adding the green onions at the end.
Warm the milk, then mash it into the potatoes with the rest of the butter.
Fold in the cabbage, season and serve with a knob of butter on top.

recipes.title: Celeriac and Potato Mash
steps: Boil the celeriac and potatoes together for 18 to 20 minutes until soft.
Drain and mash with the butter and warm milk.
Season with salt and white pepper.

recipes.title: Hasselback Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Lay each potato between two chopsticks and cut thin slices down to the chopsticks so it stays joined at the base.
Mix the butter, oil and garlic and brush over, getting into the cuts.
Roast 45 to 50 minutes, brushing again halfway, until crisp.
Sprinkle with parmesan and salt for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Smashed Potatoes with Garlic
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 to 20 minutes until tender, then drain.
Put on an oiled tray and press each one flat with a glass.
Drizzle with oil and garlic, season and roast at 220°C (425°F) for 25 minutes until crisp.
Scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Potatoes Lyonnaise
steps: Boil the potato slices for 5 minutes and drain.
Cook the onions slowly in 1 tbsp butter for 15 minutes until golden.
Fry the potatoes in the oil and remaining butter in batches until crisp.
Toss with the onions, season and finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Sauteed Kale with Garlic and Lemon
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic and chili until fragrant.
Add the kale and a splash of water, cover and cook 4 minutes.
Uncover and toss until tender, then season and squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Creamed Spinach
steps: Wilt the spinach in a large pan with a splash of water, then squeeze dry and chop.
Soften the shallot and garlic in the butter.
Stir in the cream cheese, milk, parmesan and nutmeg until smooth.
Fold in the spinach and heat through.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Cabbage with Garlic
steps: Heat the oil in a wok until very hot and fry the garlic for 20 seconds.
Add the cabbage and stir-fry 4 minutes until wilted with some charred edges.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar and sugar and toss.

recipes.title: Peas with Mint and Butter
steps: Cook the peas in boiling salted water for 3 minutes.
Drain and toss with the butter, mint and a little salt.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Corn on the Cob
steps: Boil the corn for 6 to 8 minutes until tender.
Mash the butter with the garlic, parsley and salt.
Spread over the hot corn.

recipes.title: Sesame Green Beans
steps: Blanch the beans for 2 minutes and drain.
Stir-fry in the hot oil with the garlic for 3 minutes until blistered.
Toss with the soy sauce, sesame oil and seeds.

recipes.title: Summer Vegetable Ratatouille
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in half the oil, then remove.
Brown the eggplant, zucchini and peppers in batches in the rest of the oil.
Return everything, add the tomatoes and herbs and simmer gently 30 minutes until soft and rich.
Finish with torn basil. It is even better the next day.

recipes.title: Glazed Turnips

ingredients.name: Turnips, peeled and cut into wedges

steps: Put the turnips, butter, sugar and stock in a wide pan in one layer.
Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until the turnips are tender and the liquid has reduced.
Keep cooking, shaking the pan, until they are coated in a shiny glaze.

recipes.title: Sauteed Zucchini and Corn
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the zucchini, corn and cumin and cook 6 minutes until tender.
Season, squeeze over lime and top with the cheese.

recipes.title: Saffron Rice
steps: Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp hot water.
Rinse the rice, then fry it in the butter for 1 minute.
Add the water, saffron and salt, bring to a boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.title: Brown Butter Orzo with Parmesan
steps: Cook the orzo in the butter, stirring, until both are toasty brown.
Add the stock and simmer 9 to 10 minutes, stirring, until absorbed.
Stir in the parmesan and parsley.

recipes.title: Rice Pilaf with Vermicelli
steps: Toast the vermicelli in the butter until golden brown.
Add the rinsed rice and stir 1 minute.
Add the stock and salt, bring to a boil, cover and cook on low 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.title: Mushroom Rice
steps: Fry the mushrooms and onion in the butter for 6 minutes.
Add the rice and thyme and stir 1 minute.
Add the stock, cover and cook on low 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.title: Coconut Turmeric Rice
steps: Rinse the rice well.
Put everything in a pan, bring to a boil, cover and cook on low 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes, remove the lemongrass and fluff.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Rice
steps: Fry the garlic in the butter for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the rice and stir to coat.
Add the stock, cover and cook on low 15 minutes.
Fluff and stir in the parsley.

recipes.title: Herbed Bulgur Pilaf
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, stir in the tomato paste.
Add the bulgur and stock, cover and simmer 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat 5 minutes, fluff and stir in the parsley.

recipes.title: Creamy Polenta
steps: Bring the water to a boil with 1 tsp salt.
Whisk in the polenta slowly and cook, stirring often, as the packet says (5 minutes for quick-cook).
Beat in the butter and parmesan.

recipes.title: Mexican Black Beans
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the beans with their liquid, cumin and oregano and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Season and squeeze over lime.

recipes.title: Braised White Beans with Garlic
steps: Warm the garlic and rosemary in the oil until fragrant.
Add the beans and stock and simmer 10 minutes, crushing a few beans to thicken.
Season and drizzle with more oil.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Roasted Potatoes
steps: Toss the potatoes with the oil, garlic powder, paprika and salt.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 18 to 20 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp outside and tender inside.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Broccoli
steps: Toss the broccoli with the oil, garlic powder and salt.
Air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 7 to 8 minutes, shaking once, until crisp at the tips.
Squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Zucchini Chips
steps: Dip the zucchini in beaten egg, then in the panko mixed with parmesan.
Spray and air fry in a single layer at 200°C (400°F) for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Onion Rings
steps: Coat the rings in seasoned flour, then in the egg whisked with buttermilk, then panko mixed with paprika.
Spray and air fry at 200°C (400°F) in batches for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until golden.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Green Beans
steps: Toss the beans with the oil, garlic powder and salt.
Air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 7 to 8 minutes, shaking once.
Toss with parmesan.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Corn on the Cob
steps: Brush the corn with half the butter.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 10 to 12 minutes, turning halfway, until charred in spots.
Brush with the rest of the butter, sprinkle with chili and salt and squeeze over lime.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Cauliflower with Turmeric
steps: Toss the cauliflower with the oil and spices.
Air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 12 to 14 minutes, shaking twice, until tender and browned.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Butternut Squash
steps: Toss the squash with the oil, sage and salt.
Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 15 to 18 minutes, shaking twice.
Drizzle with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Pear and Ginger Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy, then mix in the nuts.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Rhubarb and Strawberry Crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Cherry Almond Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy, then mix in the nuts.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Plum Crumble with Cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Mixed Berry Oat Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Peach and Blueberry Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish.
Toss the fruit with the sugar, spices and cornstarch and spread in the dish.
Rub the flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon, salt and butter together with your fingertips until clumpy.
Scatter the topping over the fruit and bake 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm with ice cream, yogurt or custard.

recipes.title: Vanilla Custard Pudding
steps: Whisk the yolks, sugar, cornstarch and salt in a pan, then whisk in the milk.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until it thickens and bubbles, then cook 1 minute more.
Off the heat stir in the butter and vanilla.
Pour into cups, press plastic wrap on the surface and chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pudding
steps: Melt the butter with the brown sugar and cook 3 minutes until bubbling and darker.
Whisk the milk, cornstarch, yolks and salt and pour in slowly, whisking.
Cook, whisking, until thick, about 5 minutes.
Add the vanilla, pour into cups and chill.

recipes.title: Coconut Chia Pudding with Mango
steps: Whisk the coconut milk, almond milk, chia, maple syrup and vanilla.
Rest 10 minutes, whisk again to break up clumps, then chill at least 3 hours or overnight.
Serve topped with the mango.

recipes.title: Lemon Posset
steps: Bring the cream and sugar to a boil and simmer 3 minutes, stirring.
Off the heat stir in the lemon zest and juice; it will thicken.
Pour into glasses and chill at least 3 hours until set.
Top with raspberries.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pots de Creme
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (300°F).
Bring the cream and milk to a simmer, pour over the chocolate and stir until smooth.
Whisk the yolks, sugar and salt, then whisk in the chocolate cream.
Pour into 6 small cups in a roasting tin, add hot water halfway up and bake 25 to 30 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Chill.

recipes.title: Sticky Rice Pudding with Coconut
steps: Simmer the rice in the water for 15 minutes, stirring.
Add the coconut milk, sugar and salt and cook 15 minutes more, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the vanilla and serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
steps: Cook the milk, sugar, cornstarch and yolks, whisking, until thick; stir in the vanilla and cool.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold half into the custard.
Layer wafers, bananas and custard in a dish twice, then spread the remaining cream on top.
Chill at least 4 hours so the wafers soften.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding with Cardamom and Pistachios
steps: Simmer the rice in the milk over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring often, until creamy and thick.
Stir in the sugar, cardamom and saffron and cook 5 minutes more.
Serve warm or chilled with pistachios.

recipes.title: No-Churn Vanilla Ice Cream
steps: Whip the cream to stiff peaks.
Fold in the condensed milk, vanilla and salt.
Spread in a loaf tin, cover and freeze at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: No-Churn Strawberry Ice Cream
steps: Blend the strawberries with the lemon juice.
Whip the cream to stiff peaks and fold in the condensed milk.
Fold in the strawberry puree, leaving some ripples.
Freeze in a loaf tin for at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: Mango Sorbet
steps: Blend everything in a food processor until completely smooth, scraping down often.
Serve straight away as soft-serve, or freeze 1 hour for scoopable sorbet.

recipes.title: Lemon Granita
steps: Heat the water and sugar until dissolved, then cool and add the lemon zest and juice.
Pour into a shallow dish and freeze.
Every 30 minutes for 3 hours, scrape with a fork into icy crystals.
Serve in chilled glasses.

recipes.title: Coffee Granita
steps: Stir the sugar into the hot coffee until dissolved and cool.
Freeze in a shallow dish, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes for 3 hours.
Serve topped with lightly whipped cream.

recipes.title: Berry Yogurt Popsicles
steps: Stir the yogurt with the honey and vanilla.
Crush the berries lightly.
Layer yogurt and berries in popsicle molds, add sticks and freeze at least 5 hours.

recipes.title: Frozen Banana Bites
steps: Sandwich pairs of banana slices with a little peanut butter and freeze 30 minutes.
Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil.
Dip the banana sandwiches, sprinkle with peanuts and freeze on a lined tray for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Nice Cream
steps: Blend everything in a food processor, scraping down, until smooth and creamy.
Eat as soft-serve or freeze 1 hour to firm up.

recipes.title: Raspberry Semifreddo
steps: Line a loaf tin with plastic wrap. Mash two thirds of the raspberries.
Whisk the eggs and sugar in a bowl over simmering water until thick, pale and hot to the touch (about 70°C/160°F), then whisk until cool.
Whip the cream with the vanilla and fold into the eggs, then fold in the mashed raspberries and whole berries.
Freeze at least 6 hours and slice to serve.

recipes.title: Grilled Peaches with Honey Yogurt
steps: Brush the cut sides of the peaches with oil.
Grill or griddle cut side down 4 to 6 minutes until charred and softened.
Serve with yogurt, drizzled with honey and pistachios.

recipes.title: Roasted Plums with Vanilla
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Put the plums cut side up in a dish, sprinkle with sugar, add the vanilla, juice and dots of butter.
Roast 15 to 20 minutes until soft and syrupy.
Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Strawberries with Balsamic and Black Pepper
steps: Toss the strawberries with the sugar, balsamic and pepper.
Leave 15 minutes to release their juices.
Scatter with torn basil and serve with mascarpone or ice cream.

recipes.title: Baked Pears with Walnuts and Maple
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Set the pears cut side up in a dish, fill the hollows with walnuts and drizzle with the maple syrup and butter.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and bake 25 to 30 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Bananas Foster
steps: Melt the butter with the sugar and cinnamon until bubbling.
Add the bananas and cook 2 minutes a side.
If using rum, take the pan off the heat, add it and carefully return to the heat to bubble off the alcohol (keep a lid handy).
Spoon over ice cream.

recipes.title: Raspberry Fool
steps: Cook half the berries with the sugar for 5 minutes, then cool.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold in the yogurt.
Ripple through the cooked and fresh berries and spoon into glasses.

recipes.title: Eton Mess
steps: Toss the strawberries with the sugar and leave 10 minutes.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Fold together the cream, meringue and most of the strawberries and pile into glasses with the rest on top.

recipes.title: Caramelized Pineapple with Lime
steps: Toss the pineapple with the sugar.
Cook in the butter in a hot pan 3 to 4 minutes a side until caramelized.
Squeeze over lime and scatter with mint.

recipes.title: Chocolate Truffles
steps: Bring the cream to a simmer and pour over the chocolate and butter; stir until smooth.
Chill 2 hours until firm.
Scoop into small balls, roll quickly between your palms and toss in cocoa.
Keep in the fridge.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Oat Cookies
steps: Bring the butter, sugar, milk and cocoa to a rolling boil and boil exactly 1 minute.
Off the heat stir in the peanut butter, vanilla and oats.
Drop spoonfuls onto parchment and leave 30 minutes to set.

recipes.title: Rocky Road
steps: Melt the chocolate, butter and syrup together gently.
Stir in the biscuits, marshmallows and cherries.
Press into a lined 20 cm square tin and chill 2 hours.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Icebox Cake
steps: Whip the cream with the sugar and vanilla to soft peaks.
In a loaf tin lined with plastic wrap, layer cookies and cream, finishing with cream.
Chill overnight so the cookies soften into cake.
Turn out and top with grated chocolate.

recipes.title: No-Bake Peanut Butter Bars
steps: Mix the crumbs, butter, peanut butter and sugar and press into a lined 20 cm square tin.
Melt the chocolate chips and spread over.
Chill 1 hour and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Butter Mug Cake
steps: Stir everything together in a large mug until smooth.
Microwave 60 to 90 seconds until risen and just set; ovens vary, so check after 60 seconds.
Cool 1 minute before eating.

recipes.title: Lemon Mug Cake
steps: Whisk everything in a large mug.
Microwave 60 to 80 seconds until risen.
Drizzle with a little extra lemon juice mixed with sugar.

recipes.title: Chocolate Dipped Strawberries
steps: Pat the strawberries completely dry.
Melt the dark chocolate in short bursts in the microwave, stirring.
Dip each berry and set on parchment; drizzle with melted white chocolate if you like.
Chill 20 minutes to set.

recipes.title: Affogato
steps: Put 2 scoops of ice cream in each glass.
Pour a shot of hot espresso over each.
Top with grated chocolate and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (325°F) and line a 20 cm square tin.
Mix the crumbs and butter and press into the tin; bake 8 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then the eggs, sour cream, vanilla and zest.
Pour over the base and bake 30 to 35 minutes until set with a slight wobble. Cool, then chill 4 hours before cutting.

recipes.title: Flourless Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a 20 cm round tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter together, then whisk in the sugar.
Whisk in the eggs one at a time, then the cocoa and salt.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until the top is set but the middle is still a little soft. Cool in the tin; it sinks and becomes fudgy.

recipes.title: Rustic Apple Galette
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Roll the pastry to a 30 cm circle on a lined tray.
Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon and flour and pile in the middle, leaving a 5 cm border.
Fold the border over the fruit, dot with butter and brush the pastry with egg.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden. Brush the apples with warm jam.
